column22: Meatless Farm was founded by Danish entrepreneur Morten Toft Bech in 2016 to help reduce the world’s dependency on intensively farmed meat. He and his family had struggled to find a meat replacement that the whole family enjoyed and that wasn’t expensive. In 2018, the company launched its original fresh mince in Sainsbury’s and is now one of the UK’s fastest growing plant-based brands, available in 24 countries with major retail and foodservice partners. Meatless Farm’s products include plant-based mince, chicken cutlet, nuggets, and burger patties which use less land and water to produce versus their meat counterparts. It has just won the Food and Drink Federation’s Innovation award, having previously won their Emerging Business award. Meatless Farm and global football giant Real Madrid have also teamed up on a joint mission to help drive education and action on more sustainable eating around the world.

Re- is a sustainable packaged food brand which offers tasty, all-natural and healthy products. Featuring guilt-free goodness, our delicious range is gluten-free and has no added refined sugar, colorings, preservatives and additives.

Our philosophy is that everything we do must be better for people, farmers, their communities, and our planet. With every Re- product you purchase, you will be helping to boost the active causes we believe in, from women empowerment to the use of renewable energy sources and improving farmers’ livelihoods.  ​

column22:
The “Roaring Forties” are named after the ferocious winds that circle the southern hemisphere at the 40th degrees of latitude.

Distant oceanic storms and swells that push up from Antarctica give rise to regular and strong westerly winds.

Blowing over thousands of kilometres of southern ocean, these famous trade winds carry the cleanest air in the world – as measured by the CSIRO monitoring station at Cape Grim.

With the climate tempered by the regular climate that the winds bring, the fertile lands of Southern Victoria and Tasmania provide green grass – year round.

It is one of the most ideal regions in the world to grow premium lamb.

Hip Chocolate is a premium chocolate brand that combines delicious taste with innovative design. Using only the finest ingredients, Hip Chocolate offers a range of unique flavors and textures that cater to the modern palate. With a commitment to sustainability and ethical sourcing, Hip Chocolate takes pride in their eco-friendly packaging and responsible production methods. Whether enjoyed as a treat for yourself or shared as a gift, Hip Chocolate promises an indulgent experience that is both stylish and sustainable.

Haton Champagne, the luxurious French champagne that embodies the rich heritage and artistry of the Champagne region. With over 100 years of experience, Haton Champagne offers exquisite quality, using only the finest grapes and traditional winemaking methods. Every bottle is a celebration of elegance and sophistication, perfect for toasting to life's special moments.

Bostock Brothers Organic Free Range Chicken is a certified organic, premium product that meets international welfare standards. Ben and George Bostock grew up on their family’s organic apple orchard in sunny Hawke’s Bay and share a family passion for healthy, safe growing practices where there is control from the farm to plate. This means no chemicals, no antibiotics, no hormones and no genetic modification.

The birds enjoy a happy life roaming freely among the apple trees and are housed in uniquely designed French chalets, which are clean and spacious and enable the chickens to roam freely outside once they are fully feathered.

Nutra Organics is a health and wellness brand that offers a range of organic and wholefood products designed to support a healthy lifestyle. With a commitment to using only the highest quality ingredients, Nutra Organics' products are free from artificial colors, flavors, and preservatives, and are packed full of essential vitamins, minerals, and nutrients. From superfood blends to protein powders, Nutra Organics is dedicated to helping you feel your best, naturally.

Maleny Food Co., the artisanal food brand that brings a taste of the Sunshine Coast in Queensland, Australia, to your freezer with their delicious ice cream. Made with fresh, locally-sourced ingredients, each scoop of Maleny Food Co.'s ice cream is a creamy and indulgent treat. From classic flavors like vanilla bean and chocolate to more unique options like macadamia honeycomb and mango sorbet, there's a flavor for every taste. Satisfy your sweet tooth and taste the Sunshine Coast with Maleny Food Co.'s ice cream.

You won’t be able to get enough of our  organic roasted seaweed snacks and bites  - crunchy, papery thin and delicious!

This superfood from the sea is an honest tasty snack that packs a punch with nutrients and minerals.

With a variety of flavours, sizes and products available, they’re the perfect snack for kids and adults. Certified organic and Australian owned, our Honest Sea products are also gluten free, non-GMO and Kosher with some vegan options.

Bio Living are the exclusive wholesaler and distributor of Honest Sea in Australia

The vegetables from La Catedral de Navarra boast an outstanding and refined flavour. The secret lies in the rich fertile soil, thanks to the extreme temperatures and abundant rainfall, typical of the Navarrese Ebro valley. Here, nature endows us with her delicious produce. And La Catedral de Navarra preserves it for the most discerning palates. 

La Catedral de Navarra is the outcome of the firm commitment of the Sainz family, having dedicated more than 70 years to the business of canned vegetables, and their dedication to quality and respect for natural products.

Forager Project is a plant-based food brand that offers a range of organic and vegan products made from high-quality, whole food ingredients. Founded in 2013, the company is committed to creating delicious and nutritious foods that are good for people and the planet. Their product line includes plant-based milks, yogurts, sour cream, and more, all of which are made without artificial preservatives, flavors, or colors. Forager Project is dedicated to sustainability, and their products are packaged in recyclable materials, further reducing their impact on the environment.

Bannister Downs Dairy has been voted the most popular dairy product in the country at the 2022 Australian Grand Dairy Awards (AGDA) – believed to be the first West Australian business to have done so in the awards’ history. The awards are the most prestigious dairy awards in Australia and showcase the very best of Australia’s dairy produce.

Rebbl drinks is a plant-based beverage company that is committed to creating delicious drinks that are both healthy and sustainable. Made with organic and ethically sourced ingredients, Rebbl's drinks are free from artificial colors, flavors, and preservatives. With a variety of flavors to choose from, including adaptogen-infused elixirs and protein drinks, Rebbl's beverages offer a unique and nutritious alternative to traditional drinks. In addition, Rebbl is committed to supporting human rights and environmental sustainability, making a positive impact on both people and the planet.

Three Wishes cereal is a healthy and delicious breakfast option that offers a new twist on traditional cereal. Made with only four simple and natural ingredients, Three Wishes is gluten-free, grain-free, and high in protein, making it the perfect choice for those with dietary restrictions or looking for a healthier breakfast option. With a variety of flavors to choose from, Three Wishes cereal offers a satisfying crunch and sweetness without any added sugars or artificial ingredients. Start your day off right with Three Wishes cereal!
At Annie's All Natural, they make yoghurts and cultured creams in a simple and delicious manner, using limited ingredients, live active cultures, and plenty of patience!

Green Meadows Beef is a family-owned farming and manufacturing business, producing grass-fed Angus beef products in Taranaki, New Zealand. Nestled in the heart of New Zealand's lush countryside, Green Meadows Beef stands as a beacon of sustainable farming and premium quality.

Mamame Whole Foods was born out of a Mama's big love. Our family lived in Jakarta, Indonesia for over 20 years, and in that time, Mama raised two children by feeding them with the most delicious foods that nature had to offer.

In every meal she cooked, she brought the elements of the earth to the table — in the form of plant-based Asian foods like natto, tofu, and tempeh.

Blessed by gifts of the local culture that surrounded us, these foods showed us delicious ways we could eat while considering both the health of the environment, and ourselves.

Mamame's hope is that our healthy foods will reach the kitchens and pantries of you and your loved ones with the intention to care and nourish — for both the earth, and our bodies.

Mamame Whole Foods was born out of a Mama's big love. Our family lived in Jakarta, Indonesia for over 20 years, and in that time, Mama raised two children by feeding them with the most delicious foods that nature had to offer.

In every meal she cooked, she brought the elements of the earth to the table — in the form of plant-based Asian foods like natto, tofu, and tempeh.

Blessed by gifts of the local culture that surrounded us, these foods showed us delicious ways we could eat while considering both the health of the environment, and ourselves.

Mamame's hope is that our healthy foods will reach the kitchens and pantries of you and your loved ones with the intention to care and nourish — for both the earth, and our bodies.

Mooloolaba Fisheries are meticulously managed by the Australian Government for ecological sustainability. They pride themselves on understanding the who, when, where, and how of their fishing practices. Utilising science and technology, they closely monitor every commercial fishing vessel, gathering valuable data on various seafood species and implementing strict controls on fish size and quantities caught.

At Little Farms, our fresh fish selection changes weekly, based on what mother nature provides. We do not maintain a set inventory but ensure that our offerings align with nature's bounty. Enjoy fresh King Prawns, Barramundi, Cod, Whiting, and more, all freshly caught in the oceans off the Sunshine Coast.

Read more: Click Here

Beekeepers James and Sarah established Nectar Honey in 2016, with a dream to share Western Australia's rare bioactive honeys with the world. 
Advocating for sustainable beekeeping, without any chemicals and sourced from Western Australia's pristine, remote regions, the honey produced at Nectar is renowned for unmatched purity and bioactivity. 
Each product is fully traceable to its origin and production process by simply scanning the QR code on your jar.
While Manuka honey is well known - Nectar Honey offers a range of single-origin, active honeys with equivalent bioactivity to the most premium Manuka. Nectar Jarrah, Yarri and Marri Honeys are from ancient forests and un-farmed, remote areas, boasting rich nutritional profiles, high in minerals, and antioxidants.

Wild Farm offers Free-Range Chicken with a focus on ethical farming, nutrition, and sustainable practices. Chickens are raised in spacious, open environments, ensuring natural behaviors and well-being. Our poultry is fed a balanced diet and raised naturally prioritizing health. Our growers are committed to sustainable agriculture and minimizing environmental impact. Choosing Wild Farm means opting for a natural lifestyle, exceptional flavor, and a commitment to ethical, nutritious, and sustainable food options.

Three Friends is in historic and beautiful Stanley where our farmed abalone, nourished by the cool pristine west coast waters of Tasmania, is nurtured and harvested for perfect texture, nutrition and flavour.

As their name suggests, their dairy is based at Paris Creek in South Australia. This is important because where they come from defines who they are and what they do. Paris Creek Farms is one of a small but growing clan of ‘bio-dynamic’ Australian farmers and artisans. This means they are absolute fanatics (in a good way) about respecting their land. They believe to the tips of their gumboots that healthier land produces healthier and happier cows. And better milk of course.

Bakkafrost salmon hails from the pristine waters surrounding the Faroe Islands, where the cold, clean tides of the North Atlantic provide an ideal environment for raising high-quality salmon. The salmon are nourished with a wholesome diet harvested from their natural surroundings, ensuring a product that is both delicious and nutritious.

Nestled in the remote southern waters of Stewart Island, New Zealand, Big Glory Bay is home to one of the world's most pristine aquaculture farms. Dedicated to sustainable and ethical practices, Big Glory Bay produces premium King Salmon renowned for its rich flavor, tender texture, and vibrant color. With certifications like Best Aquaculture Practices (BAP) and recognition from the Monterey Bay Aquarium's Seafood Watch® program, Big Glory Bay stands as a beacon of quality and environmental stewardship in seafood production.​

Founded in 2001, 180 degrees is a New Zealand biscuit maker focused on baking the most delicious, luxurious biscuits – created with love and imagination, packed with character and flavour. They started “wowing” hugry foodies 19 years ago, with a small range of handmade sweet and savoury biscuits. Fast forward to today: their winning range of Oat crackers, Lavosh and Cheesy Bites are made in small batches using the finest quality natural ingredients, with beautiful recipes that continue to amaze. As their motto says, every product is 'Created for taste', which becomes clear with every delicious bite!

4th & Heart ghee can do all the things butter can do—like make toast taste awesome and trick your kids into eating broccoli. But it can also do things butter can’t do. Like maintain its molecular integrity at extremely high temperatures and be digested by lactose intolerant people. Oh, and it also supports weight loss, improves digestion, and reduces inflammation. No big deal.

With a grant for a million acres, and a charter from England, the Australian Agricultural Company began in 1824 with a charge to cultivate and improve the vast rangelands of northern Australia. Today, AACo is known around the world for its wonderful wagyu beef, its care of over 6.4 million hectares of prime Australian pasture, and its passion and commitment to be producers of the finest quality Australian wagyu beef.

Abbeys Road has been produced using some of the highest quality grapes from Australia for Chardonnay and Shiraz. It is coupled with a label that has been designed to attract exceptional consumer attention, whilst maintaining the elegance and sophistication of how a great Australian wine should look and taste.

Absolute Organics' range follows the Australian Organic production principles: production of naturally safe, high quality, nutritionally vital foods; optimal production output, with rational and minimised use of inputs; use of recycling and biological cycles within the farming system; biodiversity protection and enhancement within the farm and surrounding areas; regeneration of lands and soils and best environmental practice of farming activities.

The 135 years old winery of Maison Saint Aix is situated in the south of France, just an hour north-east of Aix-en-Provence. With 75 hectares of vineyard, Maison Saint Aix is one of the largest estates in the AOP Coteaux d’Aix-en-Provence. It is situated on a plateau at 420m above sea level. The makers of AIX Rosé work here year after year with passion and dedication, to create the wonderful AIX Rosé.

Akesi was founded in 2011 in Singapore by two friends, Elizabeth and Victoria, with the aim to help people make improvements for their gut health and body. The health-conscious duo have developed a range of potent Bio-Fermented Tonics and Probiotic+ Powders, which will effectively support your immune system, maintain good gut health and achieve overall well-being. What makes Akesi unique is the products are 100% natural, and don’t use dairy or teas and sugar as part of the fermentation process like other probiotic drinks on the market.

Akesi’s reputation speaks for itself. The company has a strong track record of customers reporting better health outcomes after taking the products. Nutritionists and doctors are endorsing Akesi, while also buying the plant-based fermented tonics for their own families.

Life's too short to be wasting time with additives: concentrate on the good things, like Alfie's handcrafted, small-batch nut butters. They're made from nothing but the finest, tastiest and most wholesome dry roasted Australian nuts, ground fresh right here in Melbourne. They are firm believers that the art of raw goodness is in the grind, so the only thing they add is the jar.

Voltan is an Italian manufacturer of fresh filled pasta, plain pasta, gnocchi, ready-made sauces, and ready meals. It has been combining tradition with innovation since 1937, exporting top-quality Italian products from Venice to the rest of the world.

Unaltered from its deep source to the bottle on the table, the purity of Antipodes is its hallmark.
Fine water is a central element in the enjoyment of wine and cuisine - its sole purpose is to hydrate and refresh, whilst cleansing the palate. For this reason they sought out the source of Antipodes deliberately to offer a mineral water that is perfectly suited to enhancing fine dining.

In its minerality artesian water naturally carries the fingerprint of the geology through which it flows. For premium waters this clear mark of origin is their identity. The subtle minerality present in every taste of Antipodes is an expression of its terroir.

High mineral content is common in many waters, but it has a significant drying and flavouring effect on the palate. Antipodes has a very low natural minerality, comprised mainly of silica. This makes it the ideal table water for any occasion.

When Chris and Marina Antoniou began making Fillo Pastry in 1960, it was a true labour of love. Like a lot of immigrant families at the time, they dreamt of building a secure future for their young family. They had run a successful tailoring business in Glebe, in Sydney’s inner west – but they wanted to make the best life possible in their new home country.

So when an opportunity arose to supply Sydney’s two Greek cake shops with Fillo Pastry, Chris and Marina used the small space next door to their tailor shop to start making Fillo by hand. Chris had learned this intricate process soon after emigrating from Cyprus to Sydney in 1952, while working a second job in a cake shop to save money for a home. It was a laborious process, often taking 12 hours or more, but a quality product was always the first priority for Chris and Marina.

Word quickly spread. Consumers now sought Fillo Pastry for their home-cooked recipes, and a handful of Greek delis and cake shops began selling the first pre-packaged Fillo Pastry in Australia. And so this marked the beginning of the Antoniou brand in the retail market.

Arlingtons Gourmet Goodness. Better for you, better for your family. Arlingtons first opened in February 1990 as a local green grocer in Seaforth, a suburb of Sydney's beautiful northern beaches. They held a passion for delivering fresh, quality local produce and fine food to customers.


Their taste for quality food rapidly extended beyond the grocery store as they started making their own range of Arlingtons snack foods for time conscious people who were looking for a better for you snacking option.
These were derived from their great grandmothers recipes that three generations of the Arlingtons family had grown up loving to eat and they were certain other families would love eating as well.

At Artisan Green, their use of hydroponics technology in controlled, indoor environments allow them to grow 100% pesticide-free. Their quality fresh greens are locally grown and harvested right in the heart of Singapore. Cleaner, fresher and healthier, the produce is grown indoors under controlled conditions and monitored round-the-clock using state of the art hydroponics technology. Not impacting critical fauna with pesticides and decreasing food miles by growing locally are just a few of the ways in which they strive to be environmentally friendly.

When the occasion demands nothing but the best, Aurelio always delivers.

Their premium selection of sauces and condiments will delight your tastebuds and enhance your dishes. With all the benefits of the Riverina Grove range – natural, fresh, vegan and kosher – Aurelio packs an additional flavour punch thanks to certified organic, artisanal ingredients.
Avonmore is the Number 1 milk brand in Ireland, beloved in the homes of Irish families. They believe in sticking to their founding principles of innovation, freshness and quality, without compromise.
Babushka's is Australia's oldest kefir manufacturer, making authentic and great tasting kefirs using traditional methods.

In ancient mythology, Bacco is the god of wine, viticulture and fruit growing, representing all the nature in its various manifestations. Bacco's Bakeries reflects this belief with a passion and commitment to creating clean and healthy products, made to compliment wines, cheeses, oils and good food.

column19: Experience the pure goodness of Barambah Organics. Same day delivery. Free on orders over $100. Discover Singapore's freshest and highest quality groceries.
column22: Barambah Organics sources its fresh milk from its own two dairy farms, located in the pristine border rivers region of Queensland/New South Wales. The Barambah Farms are audited by ACO (Australian Certified Organic) to verify that no chemicals are used in the farming system. Every input into the farms is organic, from organic grain and pastures. This ensures the milk is of the highest quality and taste.

In 2013, they started with the idea that they could make an extremely delicious and satisfying snack with absolutely no compromises. To fulfill their mission, they combined Fair Trade dark chocolate with real, simple, Non-GMO inclusions for a completely original take on snacking. They like to think of it as Snacking. Elevated.™

Today, they're helping to make the world a more delicious place. With seven (and counting) flavor combinations, there’s a flavour for everyone. They invite you to enjoy and share in their passion of making today, and everyday, outstanding.

Bennetto Natural Foods Company was founded by Lucy Bennetto in 2010, a real food lover and inspiration behind everything they do. They’ve always aimed to do more than simply produce great chocolate. Their hope is that they inspire people everywhere, to be thoughtful in every aspect of their lives and business – not just because it’s nice, but because it’s vital to the continued wellbeing of the people and the world we live in.

Black Cow comes from 300 years of cheesemaking.
Their father made cheese, their grandfather made cheese, their great grandfather made cheese and their great great grandfather, yes, you guessed it… cheese. They were expected to make cheese. But they didn’t simply chuck this tradition into the bin. In fact, they just looked in the bin and saw how much milk was being wasted. That’s how the first pure milk vodka was born.

It takes whole food to nourish whole humans. Since 1983, Bonsoy has been crafting premium-quality drinks packed with real food for real people. Whether it’s saying goodbye to lactose, or simply your inner-health preference, Bonsoy is wholly made goodness. From soy and almond milk to organic coconut milk and water, we’re the golden halo of health. So when you visit a café and see their boxes stacked high, or open a fridge to that welcome warm glow, you’ll experience a feeling of calm.

Established in 1928, Botter uses grapes from native vines for a multi-territorial approach, spanning the whole of Italy from the North to the South. From the wines of Veneto to those of Sicily and Apulia, their selection traces out a map of Italian oenological culture and taste.

The story of the now famous Boursin Cheese started with one man, François Boursin. In 1957, this young Normandy cheesemaker opened a cheese factory in Croisy-sur-Eure, a small community nestled in northern France.

François worked quietly for years trying to perfect his signature cheese. However, in 1961 a French newspaper mistakenly reported the launch of Boursin infused with garlic, and the public loved the idea. The problem was that François had no such recipe in the works, but he quickly got to work to meet the public’s demand. For two years, he worked on his own original recipe inspired by fromage frais, a traditional party dish blended that blends garlic, fresh cream, soft cheese, herbs, salt and pepper.

Finally, in 1963, François was satisfied with his authentic soft cheese and garlic creation, and he introduced it to the world. Boursin Garlic & Fine Herbs Cheese was served at celebrations and gatherings throughout France, and it quickly became a household name.

Inspired by a family dream to move to the country and a passion for healthy food, Pam and Martin Brook transformed a run-down dairy farm in Byron Bay into a working macadamia farm and regenerated an ancient sub-tropical rainforest. It was then that the Brooks saw an opportunity to value-add to Australia’s indigenous nut: the macadamia. After months of product development in the family kitchen, trying to find the perfect product to create from the humble macadamia (mayonnaise and tartare sauce included!), Brookfarm’s amazing Toasted and Natural Macadamia Mueslis were born.

Now, 20 years on, the Brookfarm range has expanded with products sold all around the world. But despite this growth, some things never change – they never compromise on quality, they always create real food using real ingredients, and they always make sure it tastes amazing! A generational family business, Brookfarm is now led by Pam and Martin’s eldest son Will – whose own children walk the macadamia orchard, just like he and his brother Eddie did 20 years ago.

At Bulletproof, they believe that the right nutrients can help you tap into your potential and feel your best every day. They create products that fuel your path to greatness.

In 2011, Bulletproof founder Dave Asprey introduced Bulletproof Coffee: a blend of coffee, MCT oil and grass-fed butter. It embraced quality fats for sustained energy – and challenged everything they knew about nutrition. Taking charge of your health starts with taking charge of how you feel. That’s why Bulletproof creates products that power your mind, fuel your body and help unleash your limitless potential.

An offbeat brand under the Riverina Grove umbrella, Bum Hummers delivers big flavour with a dash of fun. Their signature Bum Hummer pickled onions are the best-selling favourite in this range, which also includes their hot and spicy Goat Chasers sauce.

The Farr estate is located in the Moorabool Valley between Geelong and Ballarat, 100km southwest of Melbourne. Grape growing in this region dates back more than 200 years, with Swiss settlers planting Victoria’s first vineyards here in the early 1800s. The rich volcanic soil and continental climate at their estate produces premium fruit with a flavour, bouquet and colour that is unique to their surrounding area.

Gary and Robyn Farr purchased the original property in 1994 and the second section in 1998 – the latter had been untouched for almost 40 years and consisted of dense boxthorn and noxious weeds. The final piece of the puzzle, which links the two blocks of land, was purchased by Nick and Cassie Farr in 2011, making a total of 130 acres – of which 36 acres are under vine, and the remainder maintained as grazing and cropping for cattle and horses. With a mixture of different clones and rootstocks, the grape varieties grown here are Viognier, Chardonnay, Pinot Noir, Gamay and Shiraz.

Byron Bay Peanut Butter Company isn't just another jar on the shelf—it's peanut butter, elevated. Made with 100% Australian hi-oleic peanuts from Kingaroy, Queensland, and a pinch of sea salt, their small-batch blends are crafted with care and obsession for flavour. Each batch is short-roasted to perfection, delivering a bold, rich, slightly salty taste and a smooth, satisfying texture. With no fillers, additives, or sugar, it’s peanut butter in its purest, most delicious form—just as good in a satay sauce as it is straight from the spoon. This is peanut butter done properly.

Jamie Laing wanted to open a cool, fashion-forward sweet shop. But what sweets would be good enough to go in such a shop?

Ed had another idea: why not create a sweet especially for adults that looked as great as it tasted? There were sweets made for kids and sweets for your granny, but nothing for big kids who still had a sweet tooth. Jamie and Ed set about to create a sweet with big flavour, honest ingredients and beautiful packaging…and Candy Kittens was born.

Since the start in 2012, Candy Kittens has been on a journey of evolution into a vegan and vegetarian brand that can be now be found across the UK and the world.

100% Australian made and owned, Carême Pastry is regarded as the leading producer of premium pastry in Australia. Since 2005, they have been supplying home cooks, chefs & food service professionals with a range of high-quality butter pastry products.

Casalingo is a family business originating in Abruzzo, Italy, that produces prosciutto and other Italian delicacies. The business was developed over three generations in Italy, and now operates out of Australia. Today, they use the finest grown Australian produce to manufacture high quality European style meats, including prosciutto, pancetta, chorizo, bresola, a classic range of salamis, and the finest cooked sausages - all with an authentic and traditional taste.

Salaisons Chambost is a family business that marks its beginnings in 1919, when Émile Chambost took over a traditional charcuterie in Tarare. He decided to specialise in dried sausages in 1940, and extended the facilities between rue Etienne Dolet and rue Gambetta. His son Aimé, brother Pierre, and cousin Robert took over the management in 1954 to meet Salaisons Chambost's growing demand, with the business later moving to its current site in 1985. The company reached another milestone in the summer of 2019, when Jean-Claude Chambost sold it to the Breton Jean-Floc'h Group – an agri-food firm with over 50 years of experience in the meat industry.

Miraval sits at the foot of Via Aurelia in France – an extensive route built to facilitate Roman expansion in the 3rd century BC. Today, the estate is a place dedicated to promoting the arts, including music, cinema, theatre, local food, and fine wine.

Chef’s Choice is a rapidly expanding Australian brand, owned by the company HBC Trading Australia. It was established by and for lovers of gourmet food, and those who are passionate about quality cooking ingredients. Their mission at Chef’s Choice is to provide their valued customers with the widest possible range of the highest quality products, coupled with outstanding service.

During a time of rapid development and constant changes, some things remain timeless. Chelmos, the first dairy industry in Peloponnese, is proud of the way its development and growth is anchored in its solid and unshakeable values: insistence and commitment for high-quality products; respect for the consumer; and love of the company’s employees and co-workers. Since 1979, the company has achieved considerable success in Greece and abroad, with its constant growth rates strengthening Chelmos' position in the global market.

It all began in 2004 when their founders were looking for a healthy snack. Finding nothing on the market that satisfied, they started experimenting in their family kitchen and road-testing on their kids. After many late nights and burnt saucepans, they got it right and Cobs Popcorn was born.

From the first batch, their principles have remained the same. Delicious, honest and better for you snacks. They use quality ingredients, just as you would at home, to create mouth-watering popcorn that is natural, gluten-free and made in a nut-free facility.

Cocoloco is Singapore's first raw coconut brand, founded in 2014 under Siam Coconut Pte Ltd (SiamCoco). The small family-owned company began importing and distributing fresh Thai coconuts to the local restaurant community 15 years ago, and has since grown into Singapore's first manufacturer of coconut water. Having started as an artisanal, hand bottled, fresh coconut water brand, Cocoloco has stayed true to their roots while improving their quality and food safety standards.

It’s a question often asked in the outside world: What kind of tequila do those who ‘know’ drink in Mexico?

For generations, the answer has only been known to a select group of Mexico’s most respected families and Los Bajos’ finest jimadors – they are the fortunate few who have had the privilege of tasting El Tequila Privado, a private recipe from a little distillery in Amatitán. With no commercial pressure to ever bring this private tequila to market, a small group of Mexican families had heartily supported it. For several generations, a local Amatitán artisan and distilling family has passionately produced this spirit, never veering from the centuries old codes and customs – “Los Códigos” – that have made it the most selective tequila in the world.

Founded in 1984 and named after the local town, family firm Colfiorito is a market leader in Italy for dry pulses, cereals and seeds – and far more besides. Their roots as a family company are in the earth; they are producers, with their own agricultural estate. It is in that very estate they also receive raw materials from all over the world, to be checked and selected according to their top-notch standards, with over 100,000 controls a year. From these roots, they have built a story of recognised competence and expertise within the products, allowing them to innovate in a meaningful way.

The story of Gabriel Coulet dates back to the 19th century when Guillaume Coulet, a wagoner in Roquefort sur Soulzon, began digging a wine cellar under his own house. There, he discovered cavities: natural ventilating cracks also known as the ‘fleurines’ of the Combalou hill, which made the place a privileged site to create an ageing cellar for Roquefort cheese. Guillaume officially founded the Coulet brand in 1872, with his son Gabriel succeeding him in 1906 and giving his name to what would become the illustrious family business today.

At Crackle & Co, they make a light and tasty pork crackling snack that’s all Australian and all natural. They hand-cook each morsel until it’s just right, resulting in a more-ish snack that’s high in protein and tastes great.

As an Australian family-owned business, they work directly with local suppliers, don’t use preservatives and only flavour their crackling with natural ingredients.

Crunchy and delicious – Crackle & Co’s pork crackling is a snack with a difference.

Danaeg is a cooperative- and farmers-owned company that has been delivering eggs since 1895. Animal welfare and food safety are high on their agenda, with a a farm-to-table quality system based on HACCP, FSSC22000 and KAT. Their stringent quality control requirements and unique salmonella management plan make these Danish eggs among the safest in the world. Fully committed to sustainability, their egg tray is also made from recycled paper.

Dari's Table is an Australian gourmet soup and dip producer. Its products are gluten-free, dairy-free, animal fat-free, egg-free and kosher – but most importantly, full of great taste. The brand proudly supports Australian farmers, and is committed to remaining down to earth and honest to its consumers.

Victoria native Darryl Attrill began making Darryl's Peanut Butter back in 2010, at a farmhouse in the small town of Maroona. Shortly after he started selling his creation to local markets, word spread to Melbourne, and before he knew it, there was demand all over Victoria.

In 2014, Darryl made the move to Geelong (75km from Melbourne) to start a large-scale production due to huge demand throughout Victoria. Now, Darryl's Peanut Butter is being sent to loyal customers all across Australia.

​Darryl has truly mastered peanut butter. There's nothing else that compares!

Over forty years ago, Daylesford began to turn their family's farmland over to sustainable, organic farming, first in Staffordshire and then in the Cotswolds. What began as a simple passion for real food and a desire to feed their children better has grown into Daylesford as they know it today, one of the most sustainable organic farms in the UK.

Founded by Ella Mills, Deliciously Ella is a resource to help you live better and make vegetables cool. Starting from a personal blog, they've evolved into an app, deli, collection of recipe books, series of podcasts, a range of plant-based food products and a growing social media community that sits at the heart of what they do.

The healthy lifestyle that Diego's owners Colin and Deann shared in a year of romance travelling between Southern California, Baja Mexio and Australia's East Coast, is the foundation of Diego's grassroots family business.

By providing exceptional quality and customer service with a focus on sustainability and innovation, Diego's can-do attitude has served them well over their +20 years of business.

Dr Karg's philosophy is simple: they take selected ingredients and lots of time, and combine them with traditional baking artisanry to produce the authentic quality their customers appreciate so much. Their very own “purity law” obliges them to exclusively use the best natural ingredients, which are then made into delicious crispbreads, snacks and wholegrain delights using their artisanal expertise.

As a traditional, family-owned business, they deliberately act sustainably. They offer appealing working conditions, are aware of their social responsibility, take care to have an environmentally friendly production, and try to promote regionally-produced ingredients as well as the regional aspects of their own products.

Their products are honest, authentic foods, promising a special “cracking good bite”. Whether at the office, in your free time, on the go or at home – the best crunchy creations are made in Franconia.

Eco Organics' range is made of organic products, offering a much better nutritional value when compared to regular wheat pasta due to its high nutritional content. They are commited to supporting your journey to a healthy lifestyle, by bringing GMO-free and organic food for conscious eating.

Malcolm and Melanie Rands founded Ecostore on New Zealand’s Northland coast in 1993. Part of a group that created an eco-village nestled in a valley dotted with streams and surrounded by native forest, the Rands set out to make their home as clean and green as the land they called home.

By creating hardworking, highly effective products for people and their home, removing harmful or unnecessary chemicals, the Ecostore ethos has always been to put people’s health first and give them the choice to live clean.

From one New Zealand family to another – the Rands passed the baton to the Kraus family in 2013. Now led by Pablo Kraus, their goal is to be the world’s most trusted and sustainable home and body care brand.

Today they continue to proudly develop, manufacture and pack their household cleaners, laundry, body care, skincare, baby care and oral care products at their own CarboNZero certified factory in Auckland and share them with the world.

The high quality of Elegre products is the result of meticulous care and produce selection. All recipes are overseen by qualified chefs who are dedicated to drawing all the flavours out of their fresh ingredients, and delivering a result that any chef would be happy to put their name to.

Emma & Tom's was founded in 2004 by childhood friends Emma Welsh and Tom Griffith. Proudly Australian owned, Emma and Tom established their brand's philosophy, 'Look After Yourself', and committed themselves to helping others experience health and vitality.

Using cutting edge, minimal processing techniques and a devotion to all natural ingredients, they are devoted to looking after you. Their products are free from preservatives, concentrates and artificial flavours; what you see is what you get. It is their belief that you don't need to compromise quality when it comes to convenience. They offer products that are jam-packed with natural vitamins, minerals and antioxidants so that you can feel great.

Epirus SA is one of the largest cheese-producing companies in Greece with a state-of-the-art production and packaging unit, in the region of Epirus, in Ammotopos, Arta.

Approximately 32,000 tons of sheep and goats’ milk is processed annually at the EPIRUS plant. The company’s production capacity and methods, its consistent investment in technology, research & development, plus an innovative spirit combined with in depth knowledge and experience of tradition, guarantee the excellent quality of EPIRUS products. These are exclusively represented in the Greek market by Optima SA, of the same group of companies.

Ever Eco's story begins back in 2013 when they became aware of the single-use plastic epidemic. They looked closely at the products they used everyday and set about finding sustainable alternatives.

Their flagship product, Stainless Steel Drinking Straws were the first of their kind on the Australian market and continue to be one of their best-sellers to this day.

They are passionate about making this world a better place and their goal is to inspire people to live a healthier life while raising awareness of sustainable options that are kinder to their planet. They also believe that living a low waste lifestyle shouldn't be difficult or expensive. Their philosophy is to choose well and make it last.

Evia yoghurt are fifth generation yoghurt artisans, using traditional recipes bought to Australia from Greece. All their yoghurts are made from 100% Australian milk, milk powder and authentic Greek culture.

Bored of tasteless, mass-produced mueslis on Australian shelves, they knew they could do better. So in 2010, as a young couple with a baby, they created Farmer Jo and muesli became their lives! Spending all their money and time making delicious artisan mueslis, they filled their house and people’s bellies at the local produce markets. Fast forward to today, they’ve got four babies and they’re still making that awesome muesli by hand in their kitchen with the help of an amazing team of muesli enthusiasts. Sydney was their home for years, but they recently relocated the whole gang to the Byron Bay region for some chill vibes and fresh air. Their mission is to make everyone realise how great muesli can be.

The Ferguson family business started in 1969 when Robert Ferguson commenced fishing for Southern Rock Lobster in the South East of South Australia, after a career change from farming to fishing. His son Andrew Ferguson continued the fishing business in 1980, adding further fishing vessels to the fishing operations.

Today, the Ferguson Australia Group is a third generation seafood company encompassing five family members working in the family business, managing many facets across the business, including Ferguson’s fishing fleet, export, international offices, and Australian retail and wholesale trade.

Molino Filippini is located in Teglio in the heart of Valtellina, a valley rich in biodiversity where alpine nature dominates. There, in the middle of mountains surrounded by pure air, their three generations have been processing buckwheat according to centuries-old tradition. They have always embraced their gastronomic culture with commitment, dedication and passion – while growing through new research and innovation. They have been producing organic products for over 30 years, and are constantly committed to production safety and customer satisfaction.

Cold drip coffee had never been done on this scale before. But First Press Coffee didn’t just do it for fun. They did it because they saw its potential. They realised that it can make you feel good, and not just in a superficial, 30-minute-buzz kind of way. In a way that gives you clarity of mind. They saw that they could push boundaries of taste, creating a pure, clean, bold flavour profile that just can’t be replicated. They did it by sourcing the right beans – from farmers who look after their workers … the people who live off the land. And they found a sustainable way of doing it, so that they could feel great about making you feel great. In its simplest form, they considered every detail of the process. Because when you’re the first to do something, you better set a damn good standard.

Four Pillars are modern Australian makers crafting the world's most delicious and awarded range of craft gins. Making gin anywhere would be exciting, but they don't make gin anywhere. They make it here, in Australia – the most delicious, diverse and creative place on earth. That's why they get to combine intense creativity around gin with a huge passion for hospitality and gin-fuelled fun.

Frankie's Fine Brine are purveyors of liquor soaked pickles and classic brines. Hand-pickled in the USA using the finest of brines, their beauties are begging to hitch a ride on your burger or get cosy with your next cheeseboard. Frankie's pickles are all natural, gluten-free and vegan, and come in three lip-smackingly tasty flavours, sure to win over the pickiest of pickle eaters.

Franklin & Sons is a premium range of crafted tonics and mixers, first created in 1886. The founding brothers George, Frederick and Albert quickly established themselves as experts in creating authentic, high quality refreshment, selling soft drinks from their family confectionary shop in Rickmansworth, London.

Fresh Fodder was established in Orange NSW by Max Schofield in 2008. From his small commercial kitchen, Max and the team at Fresh Fodder constantly strive to provide a great range of dips that focus on great quality flavours, and an overall business that offers great service.

Friends of Frank make big flavours in wholesome treats. Each and every bite has been made with all natural ingredients and nothing artificial – bringing goodness back where it belongs so you can enjoy cookies for days. Most of all, these vegan and refined sugar-free treats are made for the big kid in you and the little kids at home to enjoy together.

The Germain Cheese Dairy is rich in history, with its creation dating back more than a century. Founded in 1921 by Henri Germain, the business has since become a successful brand with a second dairy in Vaux-sous-Aubigny. It remains committed to the same quality, company values, and respect for tradition that have guided it for close to 100 years.

From the Blue Mountains of Australia, Gingerbread Folk bake traditional, chocolate and gluten-free gingerbread. Made from the finest quality ingredients, with a hint of ginger and a delicate balance of sweet spices, Gingerbread Folk cookies are thoughtfully packed in compostable wrappers. All products are vegan, nut-free and palm-oil free, with absolutely no colours, flavours or preservatives added.
Established in 2013, Gorilla Press is a small batch beverage producer, whose mission is to provide you with the right fuel to optimize your performance. Eat Raw. Stay Wild.

Gran Luchito are very passionate about bringing the authentic taste of Mexico to kitchens around the world.

They pour their heart and soul into Gran Luchito because they want you to discover the joy of cooking and sharing real Mexican food with your friends and family.

Here at Grounded Pleasures, they are fascinated by the depth and diversity of the cocoa world. They are all about the flavour, and believe that fine cocoa is as complex as fine wine and great coffee. The Grounded Pleasures range reflects this passion. They are committed to using quality products which showcase the world's greatest cocoa growing terroir. They process their beans naturally and minimally with care, in order to reveal their best qualities.

Herbie’s Spices offer the community of cooks and food lovers one central location to access all those hard-to-find herbs and spices. They also stock easy-to-find varieties of the freshest and best quality, so that you can stock up on all your spices and herbs from the comfort of your own home. The blends and spice mixes made at Herbie’s Spices contain no fillers, starches, MSG, free-flow agents or additives of any kind, so you know they will be rich in flavour and quality.
The Hydro Produce story begins with family. Starting as a small farm business in the 1940’s, they have grown into a national business and a leader in fresh produce production and supply.

Inés Rosales has more than 100 years of history specialising in traditional Andalusian baked goods. They hand-craft their products and employ premium quality ingredients, combining craftsmanship with innovative new methods. One of their main objectives is to promote a healthy diet, while still achieving the best quality and authentic flavours following their traditional family recipe.

Inside Out all started during one summer selling smoothies at the Bondi and Beaches’ Farmers’ Markets. They were determined to create only fresh and healthy products, but soon realised that there were no quality almond milks available that suited their needs. The existing offerings were highly processed, with poor nutrition and laden with additives, so they decided to create their own. Soon enough, their fresh almond milk became a big hit and it sold out every week!

Since then, they have expanded beyond almond milk to offer a range of 1L non-dairy milks, 350ml flavoured almond milks and cold brew coffees. In the process, they have remained committed to producing only high-quality and 100% natural products to create the most delicious almond milk around. No matter how big their business grows, they’ll always do things the right way, with a set of products that will leave you feeling refreshed…Inside and Out!

Created by two brothers with a core passion for wellbeing, and inspired by the lifelong practices of their mother and her personal quest for wellness, Jiva products are all influenced by their founders' ancient Sanskrit heritage.

Jiva is different from every other kombucha on the market. Its raw organic fruit infusions not only bring a real flavour to each handcrafted beverage, but uses a process that allows for lasting, tasty freshness. Each flavour has been inspired by the drinks that Austrlia enjoys, but with a tasty, low-sugar, probiotic twist.

Established in 1868, and with more than a century of experience, Joselito has carefully amassed the secrets of a long-standing tradition. Six generations have all shared one single goal: to make the best ham in the world.

Good looking, great tasting, do gooding drinks. Good for their planet, their growers and as good for you as a fizzy can be. #drinknoevil

Karma Cola is made with real cola nut grown by the Mende & Temne people of Sierra Leone. This is combined with vanilla bean from the Forest Garden Growers Association in Sri Lanka and organic sugar cane from the Suminter Organic Farmers Consort in India, natural spices; cinnamon, nutmeg and coriander; and lemon, lime and orange oils. Proceeds from each bottle sold go back to cola growers and their families in Sierra Leone. We're the only cola company that does this. What goes around comes around.

The House of Kaviari draws on 40 years of history to select the finest farmed caviars at the source. Grains are refined in its Parisian laboratories and then presented in individually-numbered tins. Each tin is unique, each caviar an invitation to pleasure, each tasting a moment of pure enjoyment, magical, sensual and unforgettable.

At Kelkin, their great tasting food has helped to bring joy and energy to generations of families for over 40 years. Their story began when husband and wife team Ken and Liz Kinsella, set out on a journey to make wholesome food available for everyone to enjoy. Since then, their passion for healthy living continues to inspire them to bring you delicious food that fuels your appetite for life.

La Casareccia is a food preservation company established in 1960. Since then, it has continued to bring to the table the excellence of tomatoes, legumes and vegetables, selected and packed with the maximum care.

The story of La Toscana started 25 years ago when Giuseppe started a catering business in a small seaside town in Tuscany, serving authentic Tuscan cuisine to the local community. The business grew over the years, with many Italian celebrities and business leaders becoming Giuseppe's customers. Today, Giuseppe has settled in Singapore but has not forgotten his roots in Italian food services. He runs La Toscana with a passion to produce fresh ingredients for many restaurants, using the same traditional formulas from Tuscany.
Gourmet Provisions was established in 2008 and is the leading supplier of clear pack wafer crackers to produce stores, delis and farmers' markets throughout Australia.

Late July is the sweet spot of summer. It’s a moment in time when life is simple, pure & good. It’s also their name and philosophy on snack making. From their Multigrain to their Restaurant Style Tortilla Chips, and their newest line of taco truck inspired flavors, The Clásico – they care deeply about using organic and non-GMO ingredients and making chips for everyone at the party.

The family-run Le Gall dairy has been established in Quimper, at the very heart of France’s Cornouaille region, for almost a century. Its 50 employees work day in day out, driven by their passion to do a really good job and their desire to foster excellence in terms of authentic expertise. This independence allows them to continue producing their butters and creams using traditional methods; to keep their jobs here in Brittany; to act in an environmentally-friendly manner; and to share the passion for their business with dairy lovers.

LIA combine traditional methods of cultivation with modern techniques in order to respect the sustainability of the ecosystem. They still pick their olives by hand just like their parents used to, ensuring that neither the fruit nor the tree is damaged. By using only linen sacks and pressing the fruit on the same day of its harvest, they assure that it retains all its properties until further procedure. The cold extraction method is exclusively used so that the nutritional values, taste and flavour properties of the fruit are transferred into the oil pulp. Their opaque white bottle help to keep your oil away from light, so that LIA comes to you as they have imagined it to come: right out of their roots of bliss, your LIA.

Liberate Free From Crumpets are made just for you because everyone should be able to enjoy delicious crumpets.

They are always being asked how their crumpets can taste so good and the answer is in the ingredients. Every ingredient has been chosen for its natural taste and texture so that when blended together and cooked with loving expert care, they create a crumpet that tastes so good you won't believe that it's free from gluten and all major allergens! Did they mention that their crumpets are plant-based as well?

Pastificio Liguori is one of the oldest pasta producer in Italy, with its origins dating back to 1795. Today, as they did in the past, they use only the best durum wheat from Southern Italy and pure water from Lattari mountains – a spring water with peculiar chemical-physical characteristics that distinguish the unique flavor of Liguori pasta.

Serving up Southern BBQ that's true to regional traditions while still creating unique, reimagined flavours is an art form in itself. Thanks to Grandma Lillie, a full family lineage of BBQ passion, and a commitment to craft, they believe they've mastered it. And with four restaurants and a huge variety of sauces, rubs, mixes and more – they're excited to show you why it's unlike anything you've ever tasted.

column19: Discover Little Farms: Your source for premium, fresh groceries in Singapore. Same day delivery. Free on orders over $100. Experience the finest quality and freshness today.
column20: little farms groceries, little farms delivery
column22: Our mission is to inspire healthy, happy living in our communities. Our Little Farms branded products are delivered to you together with our handpicked, trusted suppliers. This guarantees that each product is responsibly produced; made with all-natural ingredients. We make it easy for you to make healthy choices for you and your family. Trust us that we are your best choice for all-natural, healthy and delicious food.

From humble beginnings and a handful of treasured family recipes, they continue to maintain a focus on what is most important to their business. Little Green Kitchen are a family making delicious handmade products, for you to bring home and share with your family. They love good food and quality ingredients, and only use the best when they are baking for you. They use real butter and eggs, and never add preservatives or ingredients indicated by numbers. Although this may mean that their products have a shorter shelf life than many supermarket brands, it means that when you purchase their products, you are feeding your family quality baked goods made from real ingredients.

Little Joe is the global epitome of grass fed beef. Their promise is to deliver an all-natural grass fed beef product that offers a minimum marble score of four (AusMeat standard) – a feat near impossible to replicate. Their cattle are naturally raised by their accredited farmers in southern Australia, and independently audited by a third party audited to ensure they meet their stringent raising claims.

Additionally, the JBS Farm Assurance program ensures their producer base meets their high standards of animal welfare, social responsibility, environmental stewardship, and workplace health and safety. This future-proofs the pristine farming country so that future generations will have the opportunity to enjoy the remarkable dining experience Little Joe delivers.

The sum of these promises ensures that when you choose Little Joe grass fed beef, you are choosing a product that is not only good for you, but good for the cattle and environment.

Founded by mother-daughter duo, Mel and Maddy in December 2018, LOKA Foods is proudly Aussie owned and made. LOKA's aim is to champion real food, and with this in mind, strives to create the highest quality products using only the best ingredients. Working closely with Aussie Lupin farmers and choosing Australian ingredients first where possible, LOKA's mission is to create beautiful, sustainable, thoughtfully-crafted gourmet and low carb products.

Using passion and innovation to create each and every recipe, their ethos is to make your Lotus & Ming eating experience exciting, delicious and most importantly, easy.

Each of their unique premium products is handcrafted by their dedicated team of traditional chefs, using the freshest of ingredients and the finest produce available each day. Made with no preservatives or added MSG, Lotus & Ming offer an enchanting range of flavours that speaks of nothing but pure indulgence.

Whether they are to be enjoyed at home, prepared for a larger gathering or special event, Lotus & Ming's deluxe range including favourites such as their Peking Duck and Apple Wontons and Sesame Barramundi Spring Rolls, is sure to delight.

Lotus & Ming is HACCP certified, and offers gluten-free, vegetarian and vegan options.

Love Cocoa was founded by James Cadbury, great-great-great-Grandson of John Cadbury. Launched in 2016, it builds on the strong ethical foundation that John Cadbury initially espoused. These are sustainable chocolate bars with a twist.

Under their Plant a Tree project, Love Cocoa will be planting 500,000 trees by planting one tree with every product sold.

Chef Luca Ciano was born and raised in Milan by an amazing family, from whom he inherited his passion for food and respect for people. Luca started cooking with his Mum and Grandma when he was 8 years old, taking his first few steps with them in the direction of becoming a chef.

Luca’s career includes the famous 2 Michelin-starred restaurant “Il Luogo di Aimo e Nadia” in Milan, as well as international experience at London’s Millennium Gloucester Hotel, Relais & Chateaux in Bermuda, and in Australia at the Sheraton on the Park and The Westin in Sydney, and Cypress Lakes Resort in the Hunter Valley.

In 2001/2002, he took part in the Salon Culinaire International de Londres Competition where he was awarded a medal for Senior Pasta Class, and a Merit Award in the Nestle’ Master Chef Grand Prix. A number of Luca’s signature dishes from his London days have been published in Chefs of Distinction (2003 and 2004 editions).

On 23rd October 1901, 'Lurmark' became a registered trademark and the measure by which every other butter would subsequently be judged. From 1911, regular blind tastings and weekly samples have meant only the best dairies can use the Lumark Danish Butter brand, a level of control that ensures you enjoy the best butter possible.

Maison Chapoutier is a winery located in Tain-l'Hermitage in the Rhône region of France. Its vineyards have operated on biodynamic principles since 1991, with the winery observing, deciding and guiding nature in the most respectful way possible. M. Chapoutier continues to perpetuate the tradition of a family business and to share a very particular vision of the world of wine – a philosophy based on the concept of ‘terroir’, which makes M. Chapoutier the most admired brand name in French wines worldwide.

Madama Olivia is an international leader in the processing and packaging of table olives, tapenades, lupini beans and organic snacks. They want to bring the best of Italy and neighbouring Greece to consumers, helping them to rediscover the tastes of their food and land. By recalling the farmer's methods of processing olives, they help tradition and authenticity coexist with the demands of quality and food safety.

Maggie Beer is one of Australia's best-known culinary icons, and with her husband Colin, is the founder of Maggie Beer Products. A respected mentor to many, she is celebrated for her entrepreneurial skills and natural leadership in the gourmet food arena. Maggie's fame has been built on a career that spans farming, food production, exporting, food writing and television presenting.

Inspired by the Barossa Valley's abundance of fresh produce, Maggie Beer Products bases its reputation on Maggie's own philosophy of using superior ingredients, in season, to produce the best niche market gourmet products for the national and international markets.

Mamma Emma was launched in 2013 by Master Srl, founded in 1992. Its owners Adriano Bianco and Giovanni Favretto combined their engineering knowledge with their love of food, designing in-house the machinery needed to follow every stage of the traditional recipe. Today, Mamma Emma is the proud exporter of the classic Italian dumpling to over 15 countries in 5 continents.

In 1988, Paolo Facchino converted his home garage in Mordialloc into a small cheese factory. All the recipes he used for his homemade cheeses were his own, developed using cooking techniques his mother taught him. His mother's name was Lucia, which he incorporated into the brand name, 'Mamma Lucia Cheese'. Ten years later the Fresh Cheese Company was formed, when in July 1998, Mamma Lucia Cheese merged with its main competitor, Puglia Cheese. The Mamma Lucia Cheese brand has remained under the Fresh Cheese Company and has maintained the tradition of creating the highest quality product possible using the finest ingredients.

Founded in 2000, Mandy's Company produce locally made, delicious Christmas cakes, puddings and brandy sauce. Their cakes and puddings are made using solely Australian produce, and are of the finest quality, richness and flavour. Their cakes have now been enjoyed world-wide by customers from the United States, China, England, Sweden and Scotland.

Manomasa came from a light bulb moment as they were sat at the bar of a bustling taqueria, scooping zesty, fresh salsa onto perfectly hot crunchy totopos. There and then, they decided that they would put their masa where their mouth was and bring the colour, flavour and excitement of global street food home. Their motto as they dream up each new batch is simple: Anything is possible (if you add a little spirit).

La Mancha's Mano a Mano winery is impressively surrounded by 300 hectares of old Tempranillo – locally known as 'Cencibel' – vines, at an altitude of 660 metres above sea level. The deep, sandy soils produce incredibly low yields, at just 1-2kg per vine.

In spring 2009, Stephane was walking on his land tapping maple trees and getting ready to produce maple syrup. Exhausted and dehydrated, he took a sip of maple sap from the ice bucket that was flowing out of a maple tree.

After recovering quickly, he wondered why such a wonderful had never been shared with the world before. After few years of R & D to master this emblematic natural resource, the first maple farm in the world fully dedicated to the production of maple water was inaugurated.

In addition to its delicious refreshing taste, maple water contains 46 bioactives elements including minerals and electrolytes coming straight from the filtration made by the roots of the trees. They chose nature as their lab and Maple 3 maple water is now enjoyed all around the world!​​

Founded in 1982, the House Marcel Recorbet has built its reputation on manufacturing seasoning products. Located in the heart of the French Alps, Marcel Recorbet produces a fine range of French condiments using the best ingredients and maintaining traditional flavours.

Known for their award-winning chocolate bars, Marou was started by two Frenchmen back in 2011. Their home-grown, high quality Vietnamese chocolate is made from 100% Vietnamese ingredients, and cacao beans that have been carefully grown and selected from six South Vietnamese provinces. Stretching from the Mekong Delta to Central Highlights, each bar captures the character of their origin terroir.

Martimucci is a milling company that has led the Italian cereal sector for over half a century. It is located in the Apulian Murgian hills, where the land yields grain with special qualities. It was founded in 1953 by Giovanni Martimucci, and is now run by the three brothers Giuseppe, Salvatore and Michele. Today, Martimucci represents a reference point in the production of high quality semolina and remilled durum wheat semolina, for both bakery products and high quality pasta.

The Masoni family preserves the tradition and taste of Sienese sweets through the use of simple ingredients; high quality raw materials; a modern production process that retains its ties to the past; and, most importantly, recipes passed down from generation to generation. Masoni bears witness to the family’s long history in the confectionery field, linking together tradition, respect for the Sienese confectionery culture, and the unique flavour of its pastries.

In 1982, Massel released its first 100% plant-based range of vegan stock to the Australian market. The goal was to make a healthy, affordable, stock with great flavour that could be used by everyone – regardless of dietary restriction, religious belief or lifestyle choice.

AB Mauri have been producing Pinnacle Yeast for the baking industry in the UK and Ireland from their Hull site since 1982. They have continually evolved to improve their product performance, shelf life, and overall quality.

McClure's was founded in Brooklyn, NY, and Detroit, MI, in 2006. They use as much local produce as possible when it is in season, and when it's not, call up the farms and speak directly to the growers to know where their produce is coming from – this way, they can be sure they are getting some of the best, freshest produce available. Their products are all natural, gluten-free, and kosher certified, with every jar hand packed by one of their talented team members. We're happy that after so many years, they can bring their family recipe to yours.

Meander Valley Dairy was established In Northern Tasmania by third generation dairy farmers to deliver the simple pleasure of rich, thick, pure cream – adding some indulgence Into everyday lives. They believe that quality food comes from quality craftsmanship, so they use high quality ingredients and take the time to carefully craft their products. Today, they continue to use traditional techniques with minimal ingredients, creating a range of dairy products with a focus on natural flavour and quality.

Mekhala is dedicated to creating a better life with great, wholesome and sustainable Asian foods. Focusing on all-natural, gluten-free and vegan foods, and made from the best quality ingredients, Mekhala wants to give you healthy, tasty and easy-to-prepare Asian foods. All of their products are prepared and made by hand in small batches in Northern Thailand.

The founders of Melati wanted to create a drink that allows them to be their best selves while nailing the challenges of modern life – without the guilt, empty calories, or adverse effects of alcohol. Melati Drinks are delicious and complex for savouring at any occasion, and are infused with restorative botanicals from the Far East, inspired by ancient recipes. Melati Drinks are crafted for you to feel good about what you are drinking.

The waters off Fremantle, Western Australia are among the richest and most pristine in the world. Famous for its magnificent fresh seafood and some of the best sardines in the world, they are the ideal fishery for a business passionate about sustainability and quality. It is from here that Mendolia Seafoods source their daily catch, ready to supply gourmet delights to their ever-growing local, interstate and international markets.

The founders of Meredith Dairy Farm grew up on farms and always wanted to be farmers: turning over the soil, growing food and raising animals. They eventually took the plunge and left their jobs to work as full time farmers in Meredith in 1991.

At that time, traditional farming was in turmoil and the price of wool and farming commodities uncertain. To survive on the land, they needed to be innovative and to add value to their farm produce. They love food so they decided to milk sheep, then goats, to make cheese and yoghurts. Meredith Dairy was then born.

Their love of the land and country life ensures Meredith Dairy has a positive impact on their natural world and the local community. The land provides for us, so they need to protect and improve it for future generations. Today, their vision is for their farm to contribute to a sustainable world.

Ministry of Clouds was founded in 2012 by Bernice Ong and Julian Forwood, whose dream was to make great wine with poise and character. They did just that, and Ministry of Clouds has achieved cult status in an incredibly short amount of time.

Minor Figures are an unlikely mob of painters, jazz musicians, basketball players and barbers, brought together by a love of specialty coffee and all of the creative cultures in its orbit.

They make plant-based, 100% vegan products to lift your coffee and your mind – be that in the comfort of your home or in your favourite local spot.

Mirrool Creek is a producer of premium free range lamb from the heart of the Riverina district. The recipient of many coveted awards, it is currently a supplier to some of the finest restaurants, cafes, delis and catering companies.

Hello, welcome to the land of Free'dom!

Tomas and David are the co-founders of Mister Free'd. As a coeliac, David knows how tough it can be to find foods that fit certain dietary requirements, and Tomas is a foodie always on the lookout for the best flavours and textures in the food world. They started Mister Free'd to challenge the idea that healthier snacks are free from flavour and fun. To them, it's all about natural, carefully selected ingredients, the perfect crunch, and convenient snacking without compromising on taste.

They believe that gluten-free, plant-based snacking should be more than just about choosing a healthier alternative to your favourite snack. Food free'dom is healthier snacking that is convenient and delicious – no compromises.

The aperitif of choice since 1920 – Select Aperitivo was created by the Pilla Brothers in post-war Venice, and has since been beloved for 100 years and counting. The original Venetian spritz, it is traditionally garnished with a large green olive to create the perfect blend of balance and flavour. One sip of a Select Spritz and you’ll understand why they wouldn’t dare change the original recipe.

They are Montville Coffee, a group of leaders, storytellers, innovators, entrepreneurs, and kindred spirits. As a social enterprise, they are conscious of how their actions leave a trace; impacting their customers, their producers and the environment. Since establishing themselves as the first Fairtrade and Organic Coffee Roasters in Queensland, their awareness of environmental and social issues has driven them to build a business that celebrates ethically and sustainably sourced and produced goods.

Not all coffee is created equal. At Origin, their coffee is hand-picked and all their beans are specialty graded. This means you are only getting the highest quality beans. They believe that when they make good, sustainable decisions, they don’t need to sacrifice quality.

Here's a story: once upon a time, a professional gambler from Tasmania travelled overseas, got drunk, found a weird beer bottle he liked, decided to build a brewery with which to fill it, returned to Tassie, and built said brewery.

That was 2005. The drinker was David Walsh, creator of Mona, the Museum of Old and New Art. And the brewery was Moo Brew (it still is). Since then, Moo Brew has grown into the island's largest craft brewery. What they don't drink on site at Mona, in its bars and restaurants, at Mona Foma and Dark Mofo, they ship over to the so-called Mainland.

Australian made and family owned, MOO founders Mick & Sally Sanders were inspired by a trip to France, where they discovered little glass jars of premium yoghurt. Staying true to their vision, each tub of MOO is filled with only the finest ingredients and fresh milk, sourced from Australian dairy farms.

Veteran caterer Mandy Gray founded Moredough Kitchens in 2005. Her long history in the food industry began with holiday and weekend work in cafes as a teenager. In 1984, Mandy gained her Certificate in Catering from the then William Angliss College. After many years with leading Melbourne caterer Peter Rowland Catering, Mandy moved to London, receiving an Advanced Certificate in Catering from the internationally renowned Leiths School of Food and Wine in 1986.

Mandy started Moredough Kitchens with a range of full-flavoured cooking stocks, made just as you would at home. The Moredough Kitchens line has since expanded to include high-quality grissini and mayonnaise, which are distributed to independent food stores throughout Australia by Raw Materials.

Planted in 1969, Moss Wood is an important, founding estate of the Margaret River wine region, located in the northern sub–region of Wilyabrup, Western Australia. Clare and Keith Mugford, as winemakers, viticulturalists and proprietors, have been making wine and tending the vineyard at Moss Wood since 1984 and 1979 respectively. Their exacting viticulture ensures the production of grapes of excellent quality, and they have created a stable of fine wines distinguished by their consistency over each vintage and their ability to age superbly. The Moss Wood and Mugford names have come to be synonymous with uncompromising quality.

Mount Riley Wines is a family owned and run Marlborough winery. They craft wines that are approachable and down to earth. They are guided by strong family values and a fiercely independent spirit, producing standout NZ wines that have pure, vibrant fruit flavours and aromas. They aim to capture the essence of their land in each vintage, and are chosen around the world by those who appreciate the best quality and value of Marlborough.

column18: Shop our Range of Mount Barker Products
column19: Experience the pure quality of free-range fresh chicken from Mount Barker. Same-day delivery. Free on orders over $100. Discover Singapore's freshest and highest quality groceries.
column20: chicken, fresh chicken,organic chicken,free range chicken
column22: Animal welfare is key at Mt Barker Free Range Chicken, proudly Australia’s first RSPCA Approved Meat Chicken producer and the only RSPCA Approved chicken available in Western Australia. The chickens are farmed in the Mt Barker region in Western Australia, where they are free to roam during the day and are sheltered at night. They are fed natural grains and pastures, ensuring Mt Barker chickens grow in a stress-free environment.

Mutti's mission as a company is to raise the tomato to its highest expression, a passion that has driven us for 120 years. Even today, they are still learning new things about this wonderful fruit and constantly improving every aspect of its production – to make the best tomato products they possibly can.

There are four core team members at My Berries headquarters: Directors Allison and Stuart, and 'Chief Taste Testers' Luther and baby Gabriel. They started their berry business after returning home to Queensland in 2012, and are passionate about provenance, high quality ingredients, and local farmers. They are very cautious about what their children eat, and like most families, only want them eating safe, locally grown produce. This means they are fierce in aligning with growers who care as much as they do.

At MyLife, the creators of BioCheese, they believe food should taste great and be good for you. Natural, tasty and nutritious food should be a simple everyday choice. The gift of life is yours, and you alone are responsible for its quality.

MyLife helps you celebrate life by making the choice of wholesome and healthy dairy-free food easy. Enjoy Quality. Enjoy MyLife.

At the foot of Lebanon’s Mount Sannine rests the picturesque village of Ain El Kabou. This is where Mymoune harvest their all-natural specialties, such as jams, preserves, seasonings, flower waters, and other products made with love, the traditional Lebanese way.

The lushness of the Lebanese soil, paired with the cooperative Mediterranean weather, bears exceptional fruits rich in colour and flavour. All of their ingredients are handpicked and individually selected for the best possible taste – a process which has earned Mymoune a reputation of unparalleled quality over the years.
Naked Byron Foods was founded in 1982 to bring you clean, healthy dips. They've since expanded their range to create fantastic and inspired vegan options for everyday use.
