Be well and live deliciously!

Ruffino is a winery based in Tuscany, founded in 1877 by cousins Ilario and Leopoldo Ruffino. Today, more than 140 years after its founding and over 90 years after the release of Riserva Ducale, Ruffino continues to express the history and heritage of Italy with every bottle of wine released.

RXBAR is a real food protein bar made with a few simple ingredients. The core of each bar is egg whites for protein, dates to bind, nuts for texture. Every ingredient serves a purpose. Each minimal-ingredient bar packs 12 grams of protein and contains no added sugar, preservatives or artificial ingredients. What you see is what you eat.

The story of Sahara Dairy starts in 2007, when Ibrahim Ozdemir saw a gap in the dairy market for quality natural yogurt, cheese, butter, dips and ayran, manufactured in traditional styles. Sahara Dairy seeks to innovate and explore best practice manufacturing techniques and distribution of dairy products, staying a step ahead of trends and regulatory requirements. All Sahara Dairy products are of the highest quality and value, and are deliciously healthy and nutritious.

Salad Servers was born out of a local chicken shop called The Game Gourmet, owned by their founders (and still owners), the Swift family. Some of The Game Gourmet's key customers also had retail outlets of their own, and loved their salads in the shop so much that they asked us to produce salads for them in bulk. So, they did! The rest is history. They realised creating and producing salads for their customers is what they love and do best, and they've never looked back.

Today, Salad Servers supplies businesses of all shapes and sizes across the country. As pioneers in this space, they have over 40 years' experience supplying exceptional meals to the finest Australian businesses. They've come a long way from their local chicken shop, and with their progressive facility based in Chatswood, NSW, they're always looking for ways to improve and stay ahead of the industry curve.

Salanort are a small family canning company based in the fishing port of Getaria. Since 1995, they have worked with traditional methods and produced the finest products in Getaria.

Their work philosophy strives to strike a balance between innovation and traditional production. They believe in sustainable fishing and respect towards their environment.

Salt Odyssey was inspired by the love for all natural salts. Founders Mario and Harry were enthusiasts of Greek organic food even before starting the company, with Greece being the cradle of the famous Mediterranean diet. They started by blending aromatic Greek herbs with a prime sea salt, harvested from the Salinas of Messolonghi, to create a pure salt without any loss of trace elements and minerals. A natural source of vital elements and rich flavours, Salt Odyssey's creation is arguably the world's most awarded natural sea salt.

Since 1991, Sami & Sonia have been curating the finest ingredients through traditional methods, sharing their passion for delicious authentic Middle Eastern cuisine with friends and guests. Knowing that the essence of Midde Eastern flavours is in the intricate marriage of spices and unique ingredients, they have created this beautiful range of products for anyone to enjoy and share. Sami’s Kitchen is an extension of what they started over 25 years ago, allowing them to continue sharing their heritage and love of Middle Eastern cuisine.
Samir's Natural Foods is an Australian brand located in New South Wales, producing tasty and nutritious Middle Eastern products.

Santos is an Australian family-owned company, established in 1956 in Sydney. Santos manufactures premium quality nuts, dried fruits, mueslis, cereals, and coffee, both under the Santos brand and private labels like Little Farms.

Schar has the world's widest variety of gluten-free and coeliac-safe products, spanning breads, sweet and savoury snacks, pasta, flours and cereal. A leader in research, development and innovation, Schar is the European market leader with over 35 years of experience.

Over three hundred years ago, it was common for physicians to distil herbal remedies using copper stills, harnessing the power of nature and alchemy to solve medical maladies. In 1651, one such physician, John French, published The Art of Distillation documenting these non-alcoholic recipes. At that same time, a family in Lincolnshire had started farming, hand sowing seeds using baskets called ‘seedlips’.

Centuries later, Ben stumbled across John French’s recipes and began experimenting with them in his kitchen, using a small copper still and herbs from his garden. That might have been the end of the story, if he hadn’t been given a sickly sweet pink mocktail one Monday evening in a restaurant. The result was the beginning of an idea to combine his farming heritage, love of nature, his copper still and forgotten recipes with the need for proper non-alcoholic options; a name inspired by the seed baskets carried by his family centuries before and a process of Seed to Lip: and so Seedlip was born.

Snacking has a bad rap. Most snack foods aren't made in a way that's any good for you or the planet. Serious Food are here to change all that.

Serious Popcorn is a gluten-free, light and healthy snack that they pop by hand and season to foodie perfection. From the farm to the bag, their organic corn is 100% traceable and is grown without using chemical nasties – so you can snack in a way that's sustainable for your body and sustainable for the world. They call this Sustainable Snacking.

Shelby's is a health brand inspired by pleasure that has set out to prove you can have it all. They want to empower people to indulge without insecurity, believing in healthy hedonism – a new kind of indulgence that's sustainable, a sensory experience that positively impacts the body and mind.

Sidecar Handcrafted began humbly on a balcony one balmy Singapore evening. Their very first sausages were made with the guiding know-how of their master butcher, trained in his family business in Australia from a young age in time-honoured techniques. Using nothing more than a vintage hand-cranked sausage maker, they made one sausage at a time until they hit perfection. It was an obsession.

Today, Sidecar Handcrafted is made up of a group of passionate food professionals. In strategic partnership with their hugely respected fellow foodies from Fine Palate Catering, Sidecar supplies a range of premium meats, smallgoods and cold cuts, poultry, and fish to consumers, hotels, cafes and restaurants island-wide, alongside their staple of famous handcrafted sausages. Their products are all prepared with the same commitment to quality and the time-honoured way of doing things.

Turns out, good beer can do a lot of good. Sierra Nevada shook things up in the ’80s, and it helped launch a beer revolution that’s in full force today. They keep pushing boundaries, whether that’s in the brewhouse, with sustainability, or in the great outdoors.

Based in the rolling hills of Lancashire, Singletons & Co.'s rich history in handcrafted cheesemaking means there is not much they do not know about creating, crafting, sourcing and selecting some of the finest cheeses the UK has to offer. They are proud to use techniques and recipes passed down through the Singleton family over decades.

Since 1956, Australians have loved the great taste and premium quality of Sirena tuna. Healthy, delicious and versatile, Sirena is made with the highest quality ingredients using 100% pole and line caught tuna.

The engagingly-named Smallfry Wines is the venture of Wayne Ahrens and partner Suzi Hilder. Wayne is from a fifth-generation Barossa family; Suzi is the daughter of well-known Upper Hunter viticulturist Richard Hilder and wife Del, both former partners of Pyramid Hill Wines. Wayne and Suzi's vineyards in the Eden Valley and the Vine Vale area of the Barossa Valley are both certified biodynamic and organic. They also favour natural ferments, no or minimum adjustment, and old oak to allow the vineyard to speak. Their style is food-friendly with an eye to balance and subtlety.

Somerdale was founded in 1990 by directors Stephen Jones and Ernie Waldron. From small beginnings in a Taunton townhouse, Somerdale has grown to have a turnover in excess of £32 million, of which approximately 95% is from export. It received the Queen's Award for Enterprise in International Trade in both 2009 and 2016.

For over 27 years South Cape has been offering a diverse range of specialty cheeses, perfect for adding that extra spark to your everyday meals. From deliciously smooth and creamy Danish style fetta for your avocado toast, to extra sharp parmesan to grate over pasta, they have a cheese that makes every meal a little bit more special. And don’t forget – all their cheeses are made from 100% Australian milk.

At SGBC, they believe beer should be special, but also tasty and accessible. As Singapore craft beer pioneers, the SGBC founders know they can deliver. Their SG beer is inspired by their small but diverse home, Singapore, and is made using the finest ingredients, passion, skill and devotion. SGBC is excited to introduce their beers to the community, and to share their creations with friends old and new. So raise a glass, toast, and let’s celebrate their home with a beer made for Singapore by SG.

Spiral Foods is Australia’s leading supplier and distributor of quality traditional foods with an emphasis on organic. Now in their fourth decade, their wholesale organic products are found nationally in Australia, New Zealand, South East Asia, Japan and USA. Their range includes the finest organic oils and vinegars, traditional Japanese foods, Canadian maple syrup, Mexican agave, organic pasta sauces, tomato products, and a large range of local Australian quality products.

Sprout and Kernel is an Australian owned family business that locally produces hand made nut cheeses. Their vision is to spread the wholesomeness of their hand made cultured nut cheeses to Australians everywhere.

In a competitive market where mass production continues to be the dominant force, Stag Bakeries offers its growing number of discerning customers something less ordinary.

Stag Bakeries has been an integral part of Scotland’s beautiful Hebridean landscape since 1885. Today, as the company grows, they remain a family business where their skilled workforce continues to uphold their core values. Attention to detail, pride in their work and a cast-iron commitment to customer satisfaction, are still firmly at the heart of everything they do.

Their state of the art artisan bakery in Stornoway uses traditional methods and only the finest ingredients. Add a healthy measure of creativity, and you have a range of award-winning products for every occasion – water biscuits, oatcakes and shortbread – just a small part of their extensive range.

Stefano de Pieri was born in Treviso, near Venice, and migrated to Australia in 1974. He eventually settled in the Victorian city of Mildura, where he was impressed with the local produce and wine – but frustrated by the district's lack of recognition. He begun imagining a book that would include his food memories from his native Veneto and Mildura's produce, which eventually became ‘A Gondola on the Murray’; his book was later turned into a television series of the same name.

Stefano’s Restaurant has been the recipient of many prestigious awards and continues to attract the support of many patrons. Stefano and his wife Donata continue a family tradition in hospitality, with the hope of providing variety and interest to residents and visitors who come to Mildura.

Born and raised in Byron Bay, Stone & Wood are proudly local and independent, brewing and bottling fresh, approachable beer in the northern rivers of New South Wales.

The story of Stone & Wood began in 2008 when three friends – Brad, Ross and Jamie – decided, after many years in the brewing industry, to get away from the world of big beer and start their own thing. Inspired by the idea of the ‘village brewery’ – that is, a brewery that brews quality beer while giving back to the wider community – Brad, Ross and Jamie founded Stone & Wood in a modest shed in Byron Bay’s industrial estate and began following their vision of creating a conscious local business.

Fifty years ago, after feeding thousands as a mess sergeant during the Korean War, C.B. Stubblefield, known simply as “Stubb”, opened his own barbeque joint in Lubbock, TX. The ramshackle building soon turned into a hangout for local and touring country and blues legends who would stop by to play for a plate of their favorite barbeque. When Stubb later moved to Austin, he was urged by friends and patrons to sell his signature sauce. So using old whiskey bottles and jam jars, Stubb began hand-bottling his sauce for sale, corking each makeshift container with a jalapeño. While their bottling methods have changed, Stubb’s belief in legendary ingredients, hard work and careful craftsmanship remains the backbone of the company that proudly bears his name. They hope their sauces inspire you to create your own delicious dishes in celebration of the 50th anniversary of Stubb’s barbeque beginnings.

Sunny Queen is a 100% Aussie farmer owned company, with over 80 years if eggsperience in the industry. Beginning life as the Queensland Egg Board in 1930, Sunny Queen has now become one of the most well-known, and well-loved food brands in the country. From humble beginning at local farmers' markets, you can now find a range of Sunny Queen product to suit all Aussie families across Australia.

Superbee was established in 1968 as a family’s humble honey business, and is now Australia’s leading privately owned manufacturer of pure Australian honey, Royal Jelly and Propolis. Family is still as important as ever, and these days, they’re lucky enough to share their heavenly honey with those who enjoy it as much as they do.

D. E. Thomadakis & Sons Ltd has been specialising in fine-foods import & trade since 1992. It is the exclusive importer and agent of several leading food producers in Italy, and after a decade of meticulous research, producers’ evaluations, product trials and certifications, are now proud to present Trésors de Grece: a fine selection of top-quality Greek delicacies. All its products are made with traditional local recipes, natural raw materials, and minimum industrial processing, preservatives, additives or flavour enhancers. Its products are also all certified vegetarian, and/or non-GMO.

Sustenir's mission is to change food for good by growing impossible produce in impossible places. They produce seasonal crops all year round through Controlled Environment Agriculture, so that everyone can have easy access to a sustainable life. They make sustainability convenient for all by creating produce that’s good for you, good for the environment, and good for your city. Their healthy produce is free from pesticides and environmental pollutants, and uses 95% less water than traditional farming. By growing locally, they aim to lessen carbon emissions for a happier and healthier earth.

Sweet William Chocolate is dedicated Dairy Free, Gluten Free, Nut Free & Vegan and tastes so good, you won’t believe it’s better for you! Australian made and owned, Sweet William is the delicious ‘free from’ chocolate that everyone can enjoy - because no one should have to go without chocolate!!

At Sweetness the Patisserie, each bite captures the beauty you see and holds a promise of bliss. The quality of Sweetness products is based on their belief that small, handmade production methods are good and worth striving for. Sweetness believe that fresh is best and preservatives are unnecessary – and because the earth is important, Sweetness make every effort to buy locally and organically, compost their green waste, power their kitchen with green energy, and recycle their waste.

Syndian Natural Food Products celebrate 20 years in business this year. The Australian-owned family business manufacture a diverse range of products, including delicious burgers, patties, sliders, bites, sausages and dips. More recently, they launched a crumbed range that features schnitzels, nuggets and new ready-made meals.

All of their products are plant-based, gluten-free, and made only of wholefood ingredients. They are passionate about people, health and the environment, which is why they don't use imitations of flavour like other plant-based products. Instead, they want to celebrate the amazing flavours of real food and natural ingredients.

Born and brewed in Melbourne, Australia, at T2 Tea they have taken the traditional art of tea, turned it on its head and taken it to the world. They love to create brews that take you on a journey, travelling near and far to source the best teas from all over the planet.

Sip by sip, we're building a generation of tea lovers on every continent – a brewing force for good coming together over the humble cuppa to celebrate their difference to make a difference.

Tablas Creek is the realization of the combined efforts of two of the international wine community’s leading families: the Perrin family, proprietors of Château de Beaucastel, and the Haas family of Vineyard Brands. Equally owned and run by the two families, the partnership begun in 1987 remains today as ever, even as the next generation of Haases and Perrins have stepped into leadership roles over recent decades.

Open a table with their Tahini.

In Hebrew the phrase 'Lif-to-ach Shul-chan' literally means to 'open a table', to make a huge spread, to share plates and dips, to feel the Avira (atmosphere) and feed family, community and friends.

That's why they made Tahini Neri and that's what they're all about. Not just to bring you to your tahi-knees with taste, but to share the culture with you too.

Tamar Valley is home to Tasmania's fabulous Black Perigord Truffle products, grown right on the farm in the heart of Tasmania's north. Their delicious truffles have been exquisitely crafted into a range of artisan products, including truffle butter, truffle oil and truffle salt.

Tartuflanghe was founded by Domenica Bertolusso and Beppe Montanaro in 1968, in the Piedmont region of Italy. The truffle producer has since been awarded the 'Eccellenza Artigiana' (Artisan Excellence title) by the Piedmont Region for its thirty years of experience in the culinary world.

The Tasmanian Honey Company began in 1978 as the concept of Julian Wolfhagen, a beekeeper with a profound passion for Tasmania, its wild forests and the honey that they produce. Today, they employ more than a dozen staff and export pure, beautifully packaged honey. Their success has largely been built on their passion for, and their commitment to the production of wild and uncompromised leatherwood honey, which they like to think of as the distillate of the wilderness. Julian was involved with bees as a child, however a re-acquaintance with bees and honey via a bottle of mead shared around the fire on a cold winters night, planted an inspirational “seed” that was to grow into what is now the Tasmanian Honey Company. The business has thrived ever since.

Tasmania’s Westhaven is an award-winning dairy manufacturer that has been operating for over 25 years. Located in the Tamar Valley in northern Tasmania, they produce a range of cow’s and goat’s milk yoghurt and cheese.

At Tasmania’s Westhaven, their aim is to produce products that are as close to nature as possible with no added colours, flavours or emulsifiers. The ingredients in their products, such as the fruit in their yoghurt, is sourced from local farmers.

Tempus Two is a cutting-edge brand that does things ‘just a little bit differently’.

From its spiritual home in the Hunter Valley, Australia’s oldest wine region, Tempus Two sources fruit from Australia’s premium vineyard regions to craft wines with both substance and style. They pride themselves on their attention to detail in everything they do – a philosophy that has seen the brand achieve global success.

Their approach is simple: the best regions, the best varieties. They pay homage to classic Australian varieties and styles by growing vines in unique Australian regions, like Hunter Valley, Barossa Valley, Langhorne Creek and the Adelaide Hills.

Tenuta San Guido is named after the Saint Guido della Gherardesca who lived during the sixth century. It is located on the Tyrrhenian coast, between Leghorn and Grosseto, and stretches for 13 km from the sea to the hills. The vineyards are planted up to 350 meters on the hills and have been awarded the DOC Bolgheri Sassicaia – the first and only instance in Italy of a DOC being contained in one estate.

When Anthony Terlato and his sons Bill and John became winery owners and vintners in 1996, they started with one goal: to produce consistent, quality wines as important as those the Terlato family imported and marketed during the last half century. The bar was set high, and the exquisite collection of Terlato Family Vineyard wines truly delivers.

Terra Creta was founded in early 2001 by two Cretan visionaries with extensive olive oil experience. Following he rapid increase in demand for Terra Creta's exceptional products, they expanded with more advanced, spacious facilities in 2017. Terra Creta offer single variety, single origin, fully traceable Extra Virgin Olive Oil.

That’s Amore Cheese are a fine Italian-style cheese producer and one of Australia's leading dairy brands. The company’s founder and cheese maker, Giorgio Linguanti, was the first to introduce some iconic cheeses to the Australian market. Their artisan cheeses are 100% natural, preservative-free and handmade, using traditional Italian recipes and locally sourced milk.

When they say we’re the Almond Farmer, they mean it! They grow, hand sort, carefully select and pack their almonds on their farm in South Australia’s Riverland. Their almond butters and pure almond skincare oil are lovingly crafted and packaged on their farm, to ensure the highest quality farm-fresh produce and eliminate any cross-contamination from other tree nuts or allergy ingredients. Their almond farm is located in Taylorville in South Australia’s Riverland, on the iconic Murray River. They have the ideal climate in this region for producing high-quality, tasty almonds.

The Bali Diet Organic Rice range is a global brand that is taking the world by storm. Found in key markets across the world, The Bali Diet is the number-one selling range of organic rice that is changing the lives of individuals worldwide.

Too often, they find ourselves lacking the energy to productively complete their day. One small change that can be made is to switch their rice habits. Their organic range of rice is unpolished, unprocessed and GMO-free – giving you the right dietary tools to eat healthier, protect your wellness and energise your body.

Ethically sourced in Asia, The Bali Diet cares for the community by protecting fair-trade principals and ensuring that local farmers and their families are protected.

Through four generations, the Terlatos have brought the world's finest wines to the American table as importers, marketers and vintners. Rather than focusing on a single grape or place, Tony Terlato and his family have assembled an all-star team of winemakers with the tools to create best-in-class wines from iconic appellations. These wines reflect the family's highest values, and their vision of all that can be realised from soil, grape and commitment.

The Ferm understand the power of fermentation, and have harnessed it to create a range of incredible sauces that will add a kick to any meal or snack. Even better, their sauces are all-natural, vegan friendly and gluten free. They're made using Australian ingredients, and are free from nasties like artificial preservatives, refined sugar and additives.

The Fermentary is the culmination of a life-long passion of Sharon Flynn, considered to be Australia’s foremost expert on fermentation. Sharon spent more than 20 years immersing herself in the flavours and techniques of the ancient art of slow fermentation in Malaysia, Japan, Europe and the US, before setting up her own space in the regional Victorian town of Daylesford in 2013.

The Fermentary ferment in small-batches, naturally culturing food and drinks, slowly and with minimal intervention. They aim to source their ingredients as locally and in season as possible, with each season ending with salvaged fruits that are used for their water kefirs. They use local vegetables, Australian native botanicals, herbs, barks and Franklinford spring water, so each of their ferments captures the unique tastes of their region. And, unlike current food standards which encourages anonymity, they don’t use any synthetic starter cultures or other processes to help speed their ferments – making them 'wild fermenters'.

Here at The Great British Porridge Co. they make delicious, healthy and dairy free instant breakfasts just for you. Everything in their handy little pots, sachets and re-sealable multi-serving bags is 100% natural, plant-based, gluten-free and high in fibre – thanks to all their nutty British wholegrain oats and sweet, rich dates. And that's not all: they don’t add any sugar to the recipe as it's already naturally sweet and creamy from the coconut. All you have to do is stir in some hot water, and in one tiny minute breakfast is ready. Instant porridge, instantly lovely.

The Handmade Soap take great pleasure in looking after their people, their growing tribe and their planet. They make it their business to make the world a better place, by not only lifting spirits and tickling the senses, but by raising the bar too. And they don’t just mean soap.
Australian owned and operated, The Kind Coffee Co is dedicated to making healthy, organic products. They take great pride in their work and stand committed to the art of handcrafted coffee.

Founded in 2015, The Mad Tapper is a wholesale import and distribution company focused on the best craft beers, ciders, mead, kombucha and spirits from Australia, New Zealand, Singapore and the US. They are built on a passion for craft, underlined with an obsession for quality. They employ full cold chain logistics, direct relationships with breweries and cideries, and an experienced team to deliver the best craft products and personalised service.

The Muesli Folk is a proudly owned and operated family business, fortunate to be crafting in the beautiful lush hills of the Tweed Valley, Murwillumbah, Northern NSW, Australia. The Muesli Folk craft all their amazing muesli and granola products by hand, and use only the best consciously sourced ingredients to ensure they provide the highest quality Muesli and Granola for optimal health.

The Paring has an extraordinary pedigree. Its wines are made from the vineyard blocks that are either too young or don't fit into the vintage style of the highly acclaimed Jonata and The Hilt wines — The Paring is essentially a 'chip off the old block'. Its grapes are sourced primarily from three Santa Barbara regions on the vanguard: Ballard Canyon, Sta. Rita Hills and Santa Maria Valley.

The Stock Merchant believe in real food. Their range is made the traditional way – they don’t add salt, flavour enhancers, gluten, preservatives or additives. Their aim is simple: they want to add a depth of flavour to your culinary creations while helping support free range animal farming and sustainable fishing in Australia.

Nick and Teo met whilst working in The White Rabbit pub in Oxford; Nick was front of house, and Teo a chef. They both realised so many people were looking for a different kind of pizza and didn’t want to feel excluded – they wanted delicious pizza! This is when White Rabbit Pizza was born. It's pizza for everyone to enjoy!
Owned and operated by Carey Baker-Mackie, Terrence Mackie and Bonny Jacob, The Wild Food Group blends and packages The Wild cereal products in their dedicated Melbourne factory.

Finally, an Australian made and owned, guilt-free frozen dessert that's low calorie! Treat yourself to as much Tilly's as you like, with only 275-360 calories per tub and three amazing flavours. Made with no artificial sweeteners, it can't get any better than this.

Toh Thye San Farm is a poultry producer incorporated in 1979. Their mission is to be the trusted multichannel provider of ethically farmed and sourced food products, with their flagship product being the GG French Poulet. Since their incorporation, they have added numerous companies under their wings to enhance their strategic capabilities; they are now one of the few companies in Singapore to own and operate a fully integrated farming facility.

The Tomfoolery Wines adventure in Barossa Valley began in the sweltering heat of the 2004 harvest, between best mates Ben Chipman and Toby Yap, and a tonne of old vine Shiraz. The fruit was picked with some generous assistance from friends, then de-stemmed and basket pressed to produce the first ‘Artful Dodger’ Shiraz. Over the following vintages, the boys expanded their production to include Sauvignon Blanc, Pinot Gris, Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, Mataro, Tempranillo and Pinot Noir.

Tony's Chocolonely have been striving for slave-free chocolate for the past 14 years, and have been supported, encouraged, challenged and eaten by many. They're aware of the challenges of trying to change the cocoa industry, but they'll keep going till their mission has been accomplished. With incredibly tasty chocolate, they lead by example and show the world that chocolate can be made differently. By following Tony's rules of the game for slave-free cocoa, it's possible to make slave-free chocolate and be commercially successful.

Fromagerie Henri Hutin was founded in 1922 by Master Cheese Maker Henri Hutin. Today, it has more than 350 employees and generates sales of nearly €120 million. It enjoys an excellent reputation on the export market and is acknowledged as a company with modern, high-performance industrial facilities, allowing it to meet the requirements and expectations of its customers.

TRIBE's mission is to lead a revolution in performance nutrition by trusting nature, and to inspire their tribe to reach their infinite potential. The answer always lies in nature, in the food they eat, and the places they train. They take risks, they create momentum, they make mistakes, they progress. They go further and faster together. They celebrate each finish line. They are a tribe.
True Organic is an Australian brand located in Victoria. With over 20 years of brand value and heritage, True Organic produce 100% organic, premium products using only the finest ingredients.

Tuatara began as a backyard operation in the hills above Waikanae. It was founded by Carl Vasta, an engineer with the tastebuds of a wine critic. There’s a degree of loose talk in New Zealand about “kiwi ingenuity”, most of it from people who’d struggle to change a tyre, but Carl is the living, breathing epitome of that noble philosophy. If he needed a shed or a bottler or a tank, he’d just go ahead and build one. Before too long, he’d managed to brew a superb range of ales, porters and pilsners for his friends under the name Tuatara.

Tummify was born from a belief in the power of taking a scientific approach to the way they select and combine nutrients to solve some of their greatest health issues and enable optimal wellbeing.

As with all worldly advancements they are moving from one era to a more sophisticated one – from ‘superfoods’, whereby they have simply included an abundance of good foods in their diet, to ‘precision nutrition’, whereby the same exacting standards used in medicine can be used in the way they formulate and produce the precise foods we need to keep us well.

Every aspect of Tummify has been built to deliver on the power of precision nutrition. This starts and ends with their deep passion and investment in gut health knowledge and innovation. The team of tummify foodies and scientists select only the most potent and health-giving ingredients, then perfect the formulation and production process to deliver the precise dose of nutrients needed to transform your tummy.

Two Boys Brew is an award winning premium craft drinks brand built around great taste, adventure and feeling good. The Two Boys Brew range includes their botanically infused raw kombucha, along with their traditionally brewed craft ginger beer. Their products are designed as both non-alcoholic options, and as mixers for the on-promise and premium retail markets. They use only the best sugars, organic teas and botanicals in the development of their craft drinks.

Uncle Harry’s Vegan Grill is an Australian owned and operated business.

Originally known as ‘Uncle Harry's Natural Foods’ and ‘Uncle Harry’s Natty Patty’, the Uncle Harry’s business idea began in 1994 by the late Allan Rodd. With today’s busy lifestyle, people want to eat healthy, convenient, plant-based food that is locally produced, preservative-free, with no coded or GM products.

Allan’s legacy lives on and they are committed to producing plant-based products that are healthy, easy to prepare, enjoyable, and delicious to eat.

Undivided Food Co was founded in 2016 with the launch of Australia's first certified organic fresh bone broth. The company's three co-founders are on a mission to contribute to a healthier world, with organic broth and pantry staples that use no nasties but taste really good.

Urban Forager make just the good stuff. There's no trickery in their jars of stock, just real ingredients bursting with flavour and nutrients. Each jar contains 100% real ingredients: vegetables, meat (chicken and beef stocks), herbs, spices, apple cider vinegar, olive oil and lake salt. That's it. Simple. Real. Nutritious. Delicious.

Vabori, established in 2010, is a family owned Australian brand with a core focus on developing and manufacturing natural health products. Their immediate focus is on their Wellness Collection, which involves products derived from the olive tree.

The Vabori brand was created as they saw a need for Australian made and owned health food products. It took them many years to develop and perfect their flagship product - their olive leaf extract. Today, they are one of only a very few companies that create olive leaf extract from fresh Australian olive leaves.

Valenciso, created in 1998, is a collaboration between ex Bodegas Palacios' Luis Valentin and Carmen Enciso. Guided by quality, integrity and a clear vision, they seek to make classically structured, subtle, and elegantly fine wines. They use 100% Tempranillo from low-yielding old vines in the Rioja Alta and only French barriques.

Since 1922, the vocation of Valrhona has been to create exceptional gourmet chocolate, while respecting the artisan's know-how and fine French taste. Dedicated to quality, Valrhona selects and purchases its cocoa beans directly from choice plantations, thus securing an exclusive supply of Grand Crus from South America, the Pacific Ocean and the Caribbean. Valrhona was one of the first chocolatiers to describe their chocolate in a similar fashion to wine with the labelling of such creations as grand cru, single origin, single estate, and even vintage chocolate. Valrhona is regarded as being amongst the best of the few French chocolate makers today creating their chocolate from bean to bar.

Vega Sotuélamos was founded by two friends in the 1980s in El Bonillo, Spain. It broke into the cheese market with a differentiating advantage: the production of soft cheese with pure sheep's milk, compared to other manufacturers who produced soft mixed cheese. The milestone was marked by the release of their unique rosemary cheese, which soon gained widespread recognition. Today, Vega Sotuélamos is sold in over 20 countries around the world.

Vegemite isn’t just owned and made in Australia; it tastes like Australia. The Vegemite brand has a history spanning over 97 years, and is now proudly owned by the Aussie food company Bega Cheese Limited.

Made in Port Melbourne, Victoria, Vegemite was invented in 1922 when the Fred Walker Company hired a young chemist, Dr. Cyril P Callister, to develop a spread from one of the richest known natural sources in the Vitamin B group – brewer’s yeast. After months of laboratory tests, Dr. Cyril P Callister developed a tasty, spreadable product that was labelled ‘Pure Vegetable Extract’, which later became known as ‘Vegemite’!

The Copper Rivet Distillery is an exciting and dynamic Medway based craft distillery. Drawing upon the area’s rich tradition of innovation and craft, the team will toil together to produce small batches of exceptional gins, whiskies and vodkas from scratch in bespoke stills, with the same skill that local craftsmen once fashioned world-class ships.

They’re the only spirit maker in Kent, and one of just a few in the UK that undertakes the complete process of brewing and distilling from grain to glass, ensuring their range of premium spirits is totally distinctive and unique.

Victorian Olive Groves is a pre-eminent producer of premium Australian extra virgin olive oils, olives and olive related products. VOG believes in exceptional customer service with quality at affordable prices, and sets benchmarks to which others aspire. From grove to table, VOG's production methods are environmentally sensitive and sustainable.

VOG was founded in 1997 by oil maker Peter Caird of Bendigo, in central Victoria, Australia. A production facility was established in Bendigo, the heartland of the olive producing area of Victoria. The high oil quality and environmental principles attracted Victoria's much awarded chef, restaurateur, TV host and author, Stefano de Pieri, who then became a partner in 2002.

VOG embraces the 'Lifestyle of the Olive' – nutritional and healthy food that incorporates the rich Mediterranean in its wonderful Australian context. VOG supports the Slow Food movement, which promotes healthy food production and the enjoyment of food as a socially important event in their life.

Founded in 2005, Walnut Block Wines is the vision of two brothers – Clyde and Nigel Sowman. By combining their experience in viticulture and the wine industry with their passion for fine wine, they have created a boutique winery that offers a unique range of superbly crafted, organic Marlborough wines. The estate takes its name from Marlborough's oldest walnut tree, which towers majestically above the Sauvignon Blanc vines – creating a special historical focal point for the vineyard.

Well&Truly love snacking. No seriously. They love it so much they started their company to unjunk their favourite snacks so they could eat more of them.

They’re all about making snacks that are better for you without losing that punchy, crave-worthy flavour that keeps you going until you hit the bottom of the packet. And now that they’ve rid crisps of their naughty bits, you can finally snack like you really mean it.

All their snacks are baked in small batches, made with all-natural ingredients, are gluten free and have 40% less fat than the average crisp. That’s why they're just naughty-ish, plain and simple.

The Barber family’s farm in rural Somerset, England comprises of nearly 3,000 acres of rich and lush pasture in order to cater for an impressive 2,000 well-loved Holstein Friesian cows – who in turn produce a large amount of creamy milk required for crafting cheddar and giving it that smooth taste.

As well as managing their own herd, the Barber family also source quality milk from a wealth of local farms in order to create their delicious Westminster Farmhouse Reserve Cheddar.

Westmont is the original and the only all-Australian pickle. Their products are made by Aussies, for Aussies, using all-Aussie ingredients.

Founded in 2014 by Sydney-based best mates Joel Mevissen and Calvin Lidden, Westmont came about over beers in the backyard, at a time when pickling cucumbers were hard to find Down Under. But, working together with a local farm network, they helped to develop and foster the local market for pickling cucumbers.

Using all Aussie produce, Westmont’s 100% Australian made and owned products are picked, packed and pickled right here onshore – bringing you the Biggest Crunch Down Under. Today, the range is featured on some of the best menus in the country, as well as all great grocery shelves.

White Wolf Nutrition is a specialised nutrition organisation dedicated to the health and well-being of its customers, through all natural protein powders and supplements. They were established in April 2016 on the beautiful NSW Central Coast and have experienced exponential growth since inception. The business was founded to fill a key gap in the sports nutrition market, providing supplements with only the highest quality, all natural ingredients – with an aim to using Australian-grown wherever possible. Their supplements are packed with superfoods, BCAA’s/EAA's and prebiotics, and are naturally sweetened with stevia.

Whole Kids is an Australian-owned organic food company created by a real mum and dad, Monica and James Meldrum. From humble beginnings in a tiny rented house in Richmond in inner city Melbourne, the couple launched the first organic snacks in the Whole Kids range in 2005.

Since then, Whole Kids has grown to become the largest range of award-winning organic snacks for kids in Australia. Even with two busy and beautiful kids of their own, Monica and James continue to create new and innovative healthy foods for kids, while using Whole Kids as a way to stand up and campaign on important social adn environmental issues. Their aim is to create a healthier, happier world for kids.

Wild Breads is an Australian specialty wholesale bakery producing high-quality baked goods under the Sol Breads, Nomad Breads and Wild Breads brands. Using age-old bread recipes and only the finest ingredients, their team of passionate bakers create European-style artisan breads and seasonal baked goods for every occasion. Wild Breads operates a world-class baking facility committed to excellence in baking with exceptional hygiene and food safety standards. They deliver high quality and consistency across their entire range of specialty bread products.

It all began back in 1979 when Brian had a dream of selling rare rabbit rumps from a little shop high in the hills of suburban Sydney — back in the day when “potato-slaw” was cool. Whilst customers weren’t fans of the pickled pheasant — they lined up in droves to take home their gourmet soups, and salads. That's how they first became famous!

After starting this craze for pre-packed salads, they spent the next 35 years exploring many a culinary frontier to create the wild, the weird and oh, the wonderful for some of Sydney’s finest establishments. At the end of the day, they eat, live and breathe fresh, delicious, nutritious food, and love nothing more than grabbing their gumboots, finding the freshest local produce, and cooking up a feast for the people they love.

This is not just ‘another’ soup — it’s a bowl full of life, love, and passion for all things naturally yum!

Wild River is a label from Mount Brown Estates, a company established in 2003 by father and daughter team Tony and Catherine. All of its wines are estate grown, made and bottled. There is nothing pretentious about Wild River, just great wine at a great price.

The aim of Willie's Cacao is to introduce everyone to real chocolate with pure, beautiful flavours.

10 years ago, Willie left his cocoa farm in Venezuela to set up Britain’s first bean to bar chocolate factory. He uses only the world’s great single estate cacaos, which, like fine wines, all have highly individual flavours. To preserve these flavours, he makes them into chocolate with 100% natural ingredients, taking up to 3 weeks unlike industrial chocolate.

Willow Vale Gourmet Food Co. are committed to tantalising your tastebuds with their all-natural and hand crafted selection of gourmet food accompaniments. From their early beginnings selling chutneys and sauces at local markets, they have grown and evolved considerably over the past six years. Their range has now expanded to include specialty infused olive oils, dressings, balsamic reductions, premium dukkahs and a variety of gift packs.

Willy's aspire to be a pioneer in biodynamic probiotic farming. They farm the land without a hint of chemicals or artificial fertilisers to create a natural, symbiotic balance within their organic apple orchards. This, in turn, encourages the all-important biodiversity to flourish. Ecology and sustainability are absolutely key to every step of their unique process.

All Willy’s products are grown, hand-crafted and produced with care here in Herefordshire. From the moment the apples are harvest to the final fermentation, bottling and design seal, they are proud to create good quality British product from scratch, ourselves.
Witches Falls is a highly regarded Australian winery. Awarded a 5 red star Halliday rating, it produces exceptional wines showcasing fruit from select premium Australian wine regions.

Wolfburn is the first and last whisky distillery on the Scottish mainland. It was founded in 1821 by William Smith, who named it after the watercourse it drew from – “burn” being the Scots word for stream or small river. The distillery was constructed from hardy local Caithness flagstone, whose remains can still be seen today. Smith invested heavily in Wolfburn and it quickly became a significant producer of malt whisky, with its annual production in 1826 being roughly 125,000 litres. Wolfburn whisky is always natural coloured, never chill filtered.

Established in 2004, Woodbridge Smokehouse produces some of the most mouth-watering and luxuriant smoked Ocean Trout and Atlantic Salmon available today – anywhere in the world.

Situated on the verdant south-east coast of Tasmania, Woodbridge Smokehouse is set in their own 25-acre apple orchard. Traditional hand-smoking processes using their own fruit tree wood create the delicate and distinctive flavours for which Woodbridge Smokehouse is renowned.

Their purpose-built smokehouse and processing facility combine time-honoured methods with world’s best practice smoking technology.

Welcome to Woodland, where hens roam freely among trees. On their beautiful farms, their hens enjoy the freedom of secure paddocks, as well as purpose-built and natural shelters. Every hen can roam as far as she likes within the security of the paddocks, and can often be found under the trees foraging for grubs and dustbathing. This is why they believe their eggs are the very best eggs you can buy – they're wholesome, tasty, and produced with the welfare of the hen and the environment in mind.

The Woodstock winery is located in McLaren Vale, just south of Adelaide. Owner Scott Collett sources his grapes from 18 hectares of vineyards, which include Shiraz vines that are up to 110 years old. While many see Australia as a 'New World' producer, these vineyards are a timely reminder of its long history of winemaking.
The Wyke family has been following farming traditions in the heart of Somerset for generations. With its mild climate and lush, green pastures for grazing, Somerset is the best place to make Cheddar.
Zac & Luca's was born out a desire for quick and easy healthy snacks. Their range of nuts is all natural and preservative-free, made using high quality Australian ingredients.

What grew over two centuries as a family heritage of pressing locally sourced olives from the northern hilly Beino landscape took on a full modernistic vocation in 2004, giving rise to Olive Trade and it's coveted Zejd brand.

Modernity was in no way meant to replace the traditional knowhow. Rain-fed, unbruised, and organically grown local Souri olives are still exclusively handpicked. Oil is cold-extracted by mechanical means, never using any solvents or heat, all in conformity with ISO 22,000 certification. Local farmers and produce are always prioritized, eco-friendly packaging makes the cut, and a zero waste facility ensures byproducts are diverted to irrigation or heating.

In the hills of Byron Bay amongst music and laughter, the Zest Byron Bay team hand produce a beautiful range of spice pastes and recipe blends that are simple, easy to use and full of colourful aromatic flavours. Using only quality ingredients for optimum flavour, their vibrant earthy tones will turn any dish into a sensory feast with their rich yet subtle qualities suitable for all palettes and cooking styles to enjoy.

Together they create small batch production to ensure you get the best flavour every time. They use local fresh ingredients where available and work alongside local businesses, reputable distributors and retail outlets that specialise in quality products for their flavour loving customers.

Their entire range is gluten free, dairy free, vegan and has no added sugar.

Zhen is an artisanal gin created by two childhood friends. The certified vegan gin utilises rice crops devastated from torrential rains, along with Eastern botanicals sourced from the indigenous regions of Taiwan. Zhen Gin is committed to environmental preservation and sustainability, and to providing support to Taiwanese farmers through fair trade.
